definition_zh: 一贯的；前后一致的；与…相符的
definition_en: always behaving or happening in the same way, or in agreement with something
core_image: 一条笔直的刻度线，从头到尾没有偏移
scene: 教练翻看整季的记录，发现队员的状态几乎没有起伏。Her consistent effort finally paid off.
sceneCN: 这里 consistent 指「一贯的」（第 1 个义项：长期保持同样的标准）；句意是她一贯的努力终于有了回报。

pos.zh: 一贯的；前后一致的；与…相符的

senses.title: Staying the same
senses.definition: keeping the same standard or pattern over time
senses.definitionCN: 在时间里保持同样的标准或做法
senses.example: Her grades were consistent all year.
senses.exampleCN: 她全年的成绩一直很稳定。
senses.why: A pattern only becomes visible when it repeats without breaking.
senses.whyCN: 只有不被打断地重复，一种做法才会显出形状。

senses.title: In agreement
senses.definition: matching another fact, rule or account
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事实、规则或说法相吻合
senses.example: His story is consistent with the evidence.
senses.exampleCN: 他的说法与证据相符。
senses.why: Two pieces of a puzzle are trusted when their edges fit.
senses.whyCN: 拼图的两块只有边对得上，才让人相信。

senses.title: Steady in quality
senses.definition: holding the same quality or texture without sudden change
senses.definitionCN: 质地或品质保持不变，没有突然的波动
senses.example: The sauce has a consistent texture.
senses.exampleCN: 这酱汁的质地很均匀。
senses.why: Hands and tongues notice a single lump at once.
senses.whyCN: 手和舌头一下子就能察觉出那一点疙瘩。

intro.en: Consistent comes from Latin consistens, the present participle of consistere, to stand firm together.
intro.cn: consistent 来自拉丁语 consistens，是 consistere（一起站稳）的现在分词。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and sistere meant to take a stand.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，sistere 意为站定。

items.en: Consistere described things holding their place together.
items.cn: consistere 描述事物一起守住各自的位置。

items.en: Consistens named whatever stood firm without shifting.
items.cn: consistens 指稳稳站住、不肯移动的事物。

items.en: French consistant used the word for firm and solid things.
items.cn: 法语 consistant 用它形容坚实不散的东西。

items.en: English consistent moved from physical firmness to steady behaviour.
items.cn: 英语 consistent 从实体的坚固转向行为的稳定。

items.en: It now chiefly means agreeing with itself or with the facts.
items.cn: 如今它主要指与自身或与事实相符。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base, and the meaning group names other words for a pattern that does not break.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的站立词基，近义组列出其他表示「不中断的做法」的词。

entries.definition: to be made up of particular parts
to demand something firmly
to continue in spite of difficulty
developing or moving at an even rate
happening all the time without a pause
the same in all its parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from parts that keep standing in place, then move to two edges that fit and to an even texture.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从守在原位的各部分开始，再到对得上的两条边，最后到均匀的质地。

normal.en: Con- is together and sist is stand, so consistent is standing together without slipping.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，sist 是站立，consistent 就是一起站住而不滑动。

normal.en: A ruler with no bent mark: that is a consistent record.
normal.cn: 一把没有任何弯折刻度的尺子，就是一贯的记录。

normal.en: Two puzzle edges that fit mean the accounts are consistent.
normal.cn: 两块拼图的边能对上，就说明两种说法彼此相符。

normal.en: Consistent effort is boring to watch and hard to beat.
normal.cn: 一贯的努力看着乏味，却很难被击败。

normal.en: Say the same true thing on a good day and a bad day.
normal.cn: 在顺境和逆境里说同一句真话。

abstract.en: Picture a compass drawing the same circle twice.
abstract.cn: 想象一把圆规把同一个圆画了两遍。

abstract.en: Picture a row of bricks all set at the same height.
abstract.cn: 想象一排砖都砌在同一高度。

abstract.en: Picture a heartbeat line that keeps an even rhythm.
abstract.cn: 想象一条保持均匀节奏的心跳线。

examples.en: The team showed consistent improvement over the season.
examples.cn: 这支队伍在整个赛季里稳步提高。

examples.en: Her answer was consistent with the facts.
examples.cn: 她的回答与事实相符。

examples.en: He is consistent in the way he treats people.
examples.cn: 他待人接物的方式始终如一。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consistent 记成 con（一起）加 sist（站立）加 ent：始终站在同一个位置不动，就是一贯的、前后一致的。

root: 源自拉丁语 consistere（com 一起 + sistere 站立）的现在分词 consistens，本义是稳稳站住，后指一贯不变与前后相符。

sensesIntro.en: From a pattern that never shifts, to two accounts that fit, and finally to an even texture you can feel.
sensesIntro.cn: 从从不改变的做法，到彼此吻合的两种说法，最后到手上能摸出的均匀质地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a straight line of marks with no gap and no tilt.
core.cn: 核心意象：一排笔直的刻度，既不断裂也不倾斜。

branches.en: The first sense is a habit repeated until it looks like a line.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是重复到成一条线的习惯。

branches.en: The second sense judges whether two accounts share an edge.
branches.cn: 第二个义项判断两种说法是否共享同一条边。

branches.en: The third sense is evenness you can feel with hand or tongue.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是手或舌头能感到的均匀。

branches.en: Both senses ask whether something would look the same on a second look.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在问：再看一遍是否还是这个样子。

branches.en: A steady hand and a steady sauce both refuse sudden change.
branches.cn: 稳定的手与均匀的酱汁都拒绝突然的变化。

intro.en: Consistent is built on Latin con-, together, plus sistere, to stand, with the adjective ending -ent.
intro.cn: consistent 由拉丁语 con-（一起）、sistere（站立）与形容词词尾 -ent 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base sist- also appears in insist, persist and resist, and the -ent ending marks a quality.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 sist- 也出现在 insist、persist 与 resist 中，而 -ent 词尾表示一种性质。

items.meaning: standing together in the same way
items.meaningCN: 以同样的方式站在一起

items.meaning: to be made up of parts
items.example: The team consists of four people.
items.exampleCN: 这个团队由四个人组成。

items.meaning: in the same way every time
the state of staying the same
not staying the same or not fitting
to stand firmly on a demand
items.example: They insisted on a written reply.
She resisted the urge to shout.

definition_en: happening all the time without stopping, or staying the same in value
core_image: 钟摆一刻不停地摆动，幅度始终不变
scene: 夜里水管一直滴水，声音从没停过。The constant dripping kept her awake.
sceneCN: 这里 constant 指「不断的」（第 1 个义项：持续不停发生）；句意是不断的滴水声让她睡不着。

senses.title: Never stopping
senses.definition: happening again and again without a real pause
senses.definitionCN: 反复发生而没有真正的停顿
senses.example: The constant noise made it hard to sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 不断的噪音让人难以入睡。
senses.why: A sound that never stops becomes a presence in the room.
senses.whyCN: 从不停止的声音，会变成房间里的一个存在。

senses.title: Staying the same
senses.definition: remaining at the same level or value
senses.definitionCN: 保持在同一个水平或数值上
senses.example: Keep the oven at a constant heat.
senses.exampleCN: 让烤箱保持恒定的温度。
senses.why: Science needs a number that refuses to move.
senses.whyCN: 科学需要一个不肯移动的数字。

senses.title: Loyal and faithful
senses.definition: remaining loyal to a person over a long time, a literary sense
senses.definitionCN: 长久地忠于某人，是较为书面的义项
senses.example: He remained her constant friend.
senses.exampleCN: 他始终是她忠诚的朋友。
senses.why: A heart that does not shift is also called constant.
senses.whyCN: 一颗不肯改变的心，也被称作忠贞。

intro.en: Constant comes from Latin constans, the present participle of constare, to stand firm, built from com-, together, and stare, to stand.
intro.cn: constant 来自拉丁语 constans，是 constare（站稳）的现在分词，由 com-（一起）与 stare（站立）构成。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and constare meant to stand firm together.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，constare 意为一起站稳。

items.en: Constans described a thing that kept its place and its nature.
items.cn: constans 描述守住位置与本性的事物。

items.en: Writers used it for people steady in loyalty.
items.cn: 作家用它形容忠诚不移的人。

items.en: French constant kept both the steady and the faithful senses.
items.cn: 法语 constant 同时保留稳定与忠贞两层意思。

items.en: English constant first described firm and unchanging things.
items.cn: 英语 constant 最初形容坚实不变的事物。

items.en: It now also names a fixed number in mathematics.
items.cn: 如今它也是数学里的一个固定数值。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin stand base or the same ending, and the meaning group names other words for something that does not stop.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语站立词基或相同词尾，近义组列出其他表示「不停」的词。

entries.definition: in a way that never really stops
the quality of staying the same
a clear difference between two things
regular and not likely to change
repeated many times over a period
continuing for a long time and hard to stop

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a point that refuses to move, then move to a fixed number and to a heart that stays loyal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一个不肯移动的点开始，再到一个固定的数值，最后到一颗守着忠诚的心。

normal.en: Con- is together and stant is standing, so constant is standing still and refusing to budge.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，stant 是站立，constant 就是站定不动、不肯让步。

normal.en: A clock that ticks every second is constant, not fast.
normal.cn: 每秒滴答一次的钟是恒常，而不是快。

normal.en: Constant heat keeps a cake rising evenly.
normal.cn: 恒定的温度让蛋糕均匀地涨起来。

normal.en: The same friend in every season is a constant friend.
normal.cn: 每个季节都在的朋友，才是忠诚的朋友。

normal.en: What never pauses becomes part of the background.
normal.cn: 从不停下的东西，会变成背景的一部分。

abstract.en: Picture a pendulum swinging with the same width forever.
abstract.cn: 想象一只钟摆永远以同样的幅度摆动。

abstract.en: Picture a straight line across a graph with no slope.
abstract.cn: 想象图上一条毫无倾斜的直线。

abstract.en: Picture one lamp left on in a window all night.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇窗里整夜亮着的一盏灯。

examples.en: The constant rain ruined the whole trip.
examples.cn: 不停的下雨毁了整个行程。

examples.en: Keep the room at a constant temperature.
examples.cn: 让房间保持在恒定的温度。

examples.en: She was a constant source of support.
examples.cn: 她始终是支持的来源。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constant 记成 con（一起）加 stant（站立）：始终站在原地不动，就是恒定的、不间断的。

root: 源自拉丁语 constare（com 一起 + stare 站立），本义是一起站稳，后指持续不断、数值恒定与忠诚不渝。

sensesIntro.en: From a sound with no pause, to a number that will not move, and finally to a heart that stays true.
sensesIntro.cn: 从毫无停顿的声音，到不肯移动的数字，最后到一颗始终如一的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pendulum with the same swing, again and again.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只以同样幅度一遍遍摆动的钟摆。

branches.en: The first sense is repetition so regular that it becomes background.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是规律到成为背景的重复。

branches.en: The second sense is a value that refuses to drift.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是一个拒绝漂移的数值。

branches.en: The third sense moves the same steadiness into loyalty.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同样的稳定移到忠诚上。

branches.en: Both senses describe something you can measure and predict.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述可以测量和预测的事物。

branches.en: A constant number and a constant friend both keep their word.
branches.cn: 恒定的数值与忠诚的朋友都守着自己的承诺。

intro.en: Constant is built on Latin con-, together, plus stare, to stand, with the adjective ending -ant.
intro.cn: constant 由拉丁语 con-（一起）、stare（站立）与形容词词尾 -ant 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base stat- also appears in statue, stable and station.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基 stat- 也出现在 statue、stable 与 station 中。

items.meaning: the quality of staying the same
items.exampleCN: 她的坚贞让所有人惊讶。

items.meaning: a figure made to stand still
items.example: A bronze statue stood in the square.

definition_en: in a way that keeps happening without a real break
core_image: 秒针一圈圈走过，从不停下
scene: 她一边打电话，一边在门口来回走动。He is constantly checking whether the door is locked.
sceneCN: 这里 constantly 指「不断地」（第 1 个义项：反复而不停歇）；句意是他不停地确认门有没有锁好。

senses.title: Without stopping
senses.definition: continuing without any real break
senses.definitionCN: 持续进行而几乎没有间断
senses.example: The machine runs constantly all night.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器整夜不停地运转。
senses.why: Some processes only stop when the power does.
senses.whyCN: 有些过程只在断电时才停下。

senses.title: Again and again
senses.definition: repeating so often that it starts to annoy
senses.definitionCN: 重复得太多，已经开始惹人烦
senses.example: He constantly interrupts me.
senses.exampleCN: 他一再打断我。
senses.why: A habit repeated too often turns into noise.
senses.whyCN: 重复太多的习惯，会变成噪音。

senses.title: All the while
senses.definition: during the whole of a period, without a gap
senses.definitionCN: 在整个一段时间里，没有间断
senses.example: She was constantly aware of the clock.
senses.exampleCN: 她始终留意着那只钟。
senses.why: A quiet state can last as long as the day does.
senses.whyCN: 一种安静的状态，可以和一天一样长。

intro.en: Constantly is constant plus -ly, from Latin constans, standing firm, which comes from constare, to stand together.
intro.cn: constantly 是 constant 加 -ly，源自拉丁语 constans（稳稳站住），其词根是 constare（一起站立）。

items.en: Stare meant to stand, and constare meant to stand firm.
items.cn: stare 意为站立，constare 意为站稳。

items.en: Constans described what kept its place and nature.
items.cn: constans 描述守住位置与本性的事物。

items.en: French constant passed the steady sense into English.
items.cn: 法语 constant 把稳定的含义带进英语。

items.en: The adverb constantli first meant in a steady manner.
items.cn: 副词形式最初指以稳定的方式。

items.en: It widened to mean again and again over time.
items.cn: 它的词义扩大为在时间中反复发生。

items.en: Today it often carries a hint of complaint.
items.cn: 今天它常带一点抱怨的意味。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the constant- family or the -antly ending, and the meaning group names other words for repeated action.
note.cn: 形近组共享 constant- 词族或 -antly 词尾，近义组列出其他表示反复动作的词。

entries.definition: happening all the time without a pause
the quality of staying the same
at once, with no delay at all
repeatedly over a period of time
many times, one after another
at every time, on every occasion

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a second hand that never rests, then move to an annoying habit and to a state that lasts all day.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从不休息的秒针开始，再到惹人烦的习惯，最后到持续一整天的状态。

normal.en: Constant plus -ly turns a standing thing into an action that never sits down.
normal.cn: constant 加上 -ly，把站住的东西变成一个从不停下的动作。

normal.en: A dripping tap is the sound of constantly.
normal.cn: 滴水的水龙头就是 constantly 的声音。

normal.en: If a friend says it three times before lunch, it is happening constantly.
normal.cn: 若朋友在午饭前说了三遍，那就是一再地发生。

normal.en: Constant is the state, constantly is the motion.
normal.cn: constant 是状态，constantly 是动作。

normal.en: The clock does not decide to be regular; it just is.
normal.cn: 钟并不决定要规律，它本来就这样。

abstract.en: Picture a second hand sweeping the same circle.
abstract.cn: 想象一根秒针扫过同一个圆圈。

abstract.en: Picture small waves hitting the same stone.
abstract.cn: 想象细小的浪一遍遍拍打同一块石头。

abstract.en: Picture a light left on above a shop door.
abstract.cn: 想象一家店门上方一直亮着的灯。

examples.en: She constantly checks her messages during dinner.
examples.cn: 吃饭时她不停地看消息。

examples.en: The two brothers are constantly arguing.
examples.cn: 这两兄弟老是争吵。

examples.en: Prices have been constantly rising this year.
examples.cn: 今年物价一直在上涨。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constantly 记成 constant（恒定的）加 ly：以恒定不变的方式一遍遍发生，就是不断地。

root: 由 constant 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，constant 源自拉丁语 constare（com 一起 + stare 站立），本义是稳稳站住，故 constantly 指不间断地、一再地。

sensesIntro.en: From a process with no pause, to a habit that repeats too often, and to a state that lasts all day.
sensesIntro.cn: 从没有停顿的过程，到重复过多的习惯，最后到持续一整天的状态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a clock hand that never stops moving.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根从不停下的钟表指针。

branches.en: The first sense is motion with no gap at all.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是毫无间隙的运动。

branches.en: The second sense is repetition frequent enough to irritate.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是频繁到令人烦躁的重复。

branches.en: The third sense is a state held across a whole period.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是贯穿整段时间的状态。

branches.en: Both senses describe something that fills time without a hole.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述填满时间、没有空洞的事物。

branches.en: What happens all the while is often what we later call a habit.
branches.cn: 始终在发生的事，后来常被我们叫作习惯。

intro.en: Constantly is built from the Latin base stant-, standing, plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: constantly 由拉丁语词基 stant-（站立）加副词词尾 -ly 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin stand base also appears in constant, constancy and stable.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的站立词基也出现在 constant、constancy 与 stable 中。

items.meaning: in a way that never really stops

items.exampleCN: 他的忠贞赢得了她的信任。

items.example: An inconstant wind filled the sails.
items.exampleCN: 一阵忽强忽弱的风鼓起了帆。

items.meaning: the way a body or a mind stands
items.example: He took a firm stance on the issue.
items.exampleCN: 他在这个问题上立场坚定。

items.meaning: to hold firmly to a demand
items.example: He insisted on a second chance.

definition_en: to form or make up something, or to establish it officially
core_image: 几块砖被摆成一个明确的形状，成为一堵墙
scene: 老师指着实验台上的几样器材说明用途。These small parts constitute the whole system.
sceneCN: 这里 constitute 指「构成」（第 1 个义项：若干部分组成整体）；句意是这些小部件构成了整个系统。

senses.title: Make up a whole
senses.definition: to form a whole when the parts are taken together
senses.definitionCN: 各部分合起来形成一个整体
senses.example: Ten chapters constitute the whole book.
senses.exampleCN: 十章构成了整本书。
senses.why: A whole is only a name until its parts are counted.
senses.whyCN: 整体在数清部分之前，只是一个名字。

senses.title: Amount to something
senses.definition: to be serious or important enough to count as something
senses.definitionCN: 严重或重要到足以被算作某事
senses.example: Such neglect may constitute a crime.
senses.exampleCN: 这种疏忽可能构成犯罪。
senses.why: Law needs a line where a behaviour becomes a named act.
senses.whyCN: 法律需要一条界线，让某种行为变成有名字的罪行。

senses.title: Set up officially
senses.definition: to establish an official body by formal act
senses.definitionCN: 通过正式程序建立官方机构
senses.example: They constituted a committee to study the case.
senses.exampleCN: 他们设立了一个委员会来研究此案。
senses.why: A group becomes an institution on the day it is written down.
senses.whyCN: 一个群体在被写下来的那天，才成为机构。

intro.en: Constitute comes from Latin constituere, to set up or appoint, built from com-, together, and statuere, to place.
intro.cn: constitute 来自拉丁语 constituere，意为设立或任命，由 com-（一起）与 statuere（放置）构成。

items.en: Statuere meant to set something in place and make it stand.
items.cn: statuere 意为把某物放好并让它立住。

items.en: Constituere meant to set up a body or appoint an officer.
items.cn: constituere 意为设立机构或任命官员。

items.en: The noun constitutio named an arrangement and later a decree.
items.cn: 名词 constitutio 指安排，后来指法令。

items.en: French constituer used the word for founding and composing.

items.en: It now commonly means to make up or amount to something.

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin statu- base, and the meaning group names other verbs for making up a whole.

entries.definition: the basic laws of a state, or the way something is made
one of the parts that make up a whole
to start an official system or organization
to form the parts of a whole
to consist of particular parts
to make something into a shape or body

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from bricks set into one wall, then move to an act heavy enough to count as a crime and to a body written into being.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从砌成一堵墙的砖开始，再到重到足以算作犯罪的行为，最后到被写出来的机构。

normal.en: Con- is together and stitute is set up, so constitute is setting things up into one body.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，stitute 是设立，constitute 就是把东西搭成一个整体。

normal.en: Bricks do not become a wall until they are counted together.
normal.cn: 砖要一起被数清，才变成一堵墙。

normal.en: A small act can constitute a big charge in a court.
normal.cn: 一个小动作，在法庭上可能构成重罪。

normal.en: To constitute a committee is to write a group into being.
normal.cn: 设立一个委员会，就是把一群人写进现实。

normal.en: First the parts, then the name of the whole.
normal.cn: 先有部分，再有整体的名字。

abstract.en: Picture several blocks locked into one clear shape.
abstract.cn: 想象几块积木扣成一个清晰的形状。

abstract.en: Picture a line of names signed under a new rule.
abstract.cn: 想象一条新规下面签着一排名字。

abstract.en: Picture one drop joining others to make a stream.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴水与其他水汇成一条小溪。

examples.en: Women constitute half of the workforce here.
examples.cn: 女性构成了这里劳动力的一半。

examples.en: Driving without lights may constitute an offence.
examples.cn: 不开灯驾驶可能构成违法。

examples.en: The members constituted a new council last spring.
examples.cn: 成员们在去年春天组建了一个新理事会。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 constitute 记成 con（一起）加 stitute（设立）：把若干部分一起立起来，就成了一个整体，即构成。

root: 源自拉丁语 constituere（com 一起 + statuere 放置），本义是把东西一起立起来，后指构成整体、等同于某事与正式设立。

sensesIntro.en: From parts forming a whole, to an act serious enough to be named, and at last to a body set up by formal words.
sensesIntro.cn: 从部分形成整体，到严重到足以被命名的行为，最后到用正式文字设立的机构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: bricks set down one by one until a wall stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：砖一块块放好，直到一堵墙立起来。

branches.en: The first sense simply joins parts into one named whole.
branches.cn: 第一个义项只是把部分合成一个有名字的整体。

branches.en: The second sense says an act is heavy enough to be renamed as an offence.
branches.cn: 第二个义项说某行为重到可以被改称为一项罪名。

branches.en: The third sense writes a group into official existence.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一个群体写进正式的建制。

branches.en: Both senses turn separate pieces into something with a legal name.
branches.cn: 两个义项都把分散的片段变成有正式名称的东西。

branches.en: A court and a council both depend on words that constitute.
branches.cn: 法庭与理事会都依靠那些起构成作用的文字。

intro.en: Constitute is built on Latin con-, together, plus statuere, to set in place.
intro.cn: constitute 由拉丁语 con-（一起）与 statuere（放置）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin set base stitut- also appears in constitution, institute and substitute.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的放置词基 stitut- 也出现在 constitution、institute 与 substitute 中。

items.meaning: to set parts up into one whole
items.example: These twelve poems constitute the collection.
items.exampleCN: 这十二首诗构成了这本诗集。

items.meaning: the way something is built, or a state's basic law
items.meaningCN: 构成方式，或国家的根本法

items.example: The court called the rule constitutional.
items.exampleCN: 法院认定该规定符合宪法。

items.meaning: one part that helps form a whole
items.example: Water is the main constituent of the drink.
items.exampleCN: 水是这种饮料的主要成分。

items.meaning: to set a system in place
items.example: They instituted a new safety rule.
items.exampleCN: 他们设立了一条新的安全规定。

items.meaning: a law set down in writing
a figure set up to stand
to put one thing in place of another
items.meaningCN: 把一物放到另一物的位置
items.example: You can substitute honey for sugar.

definition_en: to build something by putting parts together, or to form an idea in the mind
core_image: 工人把钢梁一根根吊起，拼成桥的骨架
scene: 工地上的吊车正把钢梁送到桥墩上。Workers construct the bridge in sections.
sceneCN: 这里 construct 指「建造」（第 1 个义项：把材料拼成建筑物）；句意是工人们分段建造这座桥。

senses.title: Build from parts
senses.definition: to build a physical thing by joining materials together
senses.definitionCN: 把材料连接起来建成实物
senses.example: They plan to construct a new school here.
senses.exampleCN: 他们计划在这里建一所新学校。
senses.why: Nothing large appears at once; it is lifted piece by piece.
senses.whyCN: 庞大的东西不会一下出现，而是一块块吊起来。

senses.title: Build in the mind
senses.definition: to form an idea, theory or sentence out of separate parts
senses.definitionCN: 用分散的部分搭出想法、理论或句子
senses.example: She constructed a clear argument from three facts.
senses.exampleCN: 她用三件事实构建了一个清晰的论证。
senses.why: Thought also needs a frame before it can stand.
senses.whyCN: 想法也要先有个架子，才能立起来。

senses.title: Draw by rule
senses.definition: to draw a geometric figure exactly as the rules require
senses.definitionCN: 严格按规则画出几何图形
senses.example: Construct a triangle with these two sides.
senses.exampleCN: 用这两条边作一个三角形。
senses.why: Geometry builds shapes with a ruler and a compass.
senses.whyCN: 几何用尺和圆规把图形搭建出来。

intro.en: Construct comes from Latin construere, to pile up or build, built from com-, together, and struere, to pile.
intro.cn: construct 来自拉丁语 construere，意为堆起或建造，由 com-（一起）与 struere（堆积）构成。

items.en: Struere meant to pile things in layers.
items.cn: struere 意为把东西一层层堆起。

items.en: Construere meant to pile materials into a building.
items.cn: construere 意为把材料堆成一座建筑。

items.en: It also described putting words together in order.
items.cn: 它也描述把词语按顺序组合起来。

items.en: French construire kept both the building and the wording senses.
items.cn: 法语 construire 同时保留建造与组句两层意思。

items.en: English construct meant to build up a structure.
items.cn: 英语 construct 指搭起一座结构。

items.en: It now also covers building an argument or a theory.
items.cn: 如今它也指构建论证或理论。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin pile base struct-, and the meaning group names other verbs for putting a thing together.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语堆积词基 struct-，近义组列出其他表示把事物搭起来的动词。

entries.definition: the process of building something
helpful and intended to improve something

to make something by joining parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from steel beams lifted into place, then move to an argument built from facts and to a shape drawn by rule.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被吊到位的钢梁开始，再到用事实搭起的论证，最后到按规则画出的图形。

normal.en: Con- is together and struct is pile, so construct is piling pieces into one thing.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，struct 是堆，construct 就是把部件堆成一个东西。

normal.en: A bridge is only a plan until the first beam is hung.
normal.cn: 在第一根梁吊起之前，桥还只是图纸。

normal.en: Sentences are constructed the same way bridges are: part by part.
normal.cn: 句子和桥一样，都是逐件搭起来的。

normal.en: A good argument is built, not shouted.
normal.cn: 好的论证是搭出来的，不是喊出来的。

normal.en: Ask what holds it up, and you will see how it was constructed.
normal.cn: 问它靠什么撑住，你就看出它是怎么建成的。

abstract.en: Picture a crane lowering one long beam.
abstract.cn: 想象一台吊车放下一根长梁。

abstract.en: Picture three blocks stacked into a neat tower.
abstract.cn: 想象三块积木叠成一座整齐的塔。

abstract.en: Picture a compass drawing an exact triangle.
abstract.cn: 想象一把圆规画出一个精确的三角形。

examples.en: Engineers will construct the tunnel in two stages.
examples.cn: 工程师将分两个阶段建造这条隧道。

examples.en: He constructed his answer carefully from the data.
examples.cn: 他依据数据仔细构建了自己的回答。

examples.en: The shelter was constructed of wood and stone.
examples.cn: 这个避难所是用木材和石头建造的。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 construct 记成 con（一起）加 struct（堆积）：把材料一起堆叠搭起来，就是建造。

root: 源自拉丁语 construere（com 一起 + struere 堆积），本义是把材料堆叠起来建成屋宇，后指建造、组句与构想。

sensesIntro.en: From beams lifted into a bridge, to an argument built from facts, and to a triangle drawn with care.
sensesIntro.cn: 从吊成桥梁的钢梁，到用事实搭起的论证，最后到仔细画出的三角形。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: steel beams hanging from a crane, joining one frame.
core.cn: 核心意象：吊车吊着钢梁，合成一副骨架。

branches.en: The first sense is physical joining, beam against beam.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是实体上的连接，梁与梁相接。

branches.en: The second sense builds arguments and sentences from smaller pieces.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用小片段搭出论证与句子。

branches.en: The third sense draws a figure by following fixed rules.
branches.cn: 第三个义项按固定规则画出图形。

branches.en: Both senses need a frame before the whole can stand.
branches.cn: 两个义项都需要先有骨架，整体才能立住。

branches.en: A proof and a drawing both grow step by step.
branches.cn: 证明与作图都是一步一步长出来的。

the act or process of building

items.exampleCN: 建造方在图纸上签了字。

items.meaning: a thing that has been built

items.exampleCN: 这座建筑在风中站住了。

items.example: A coach instructed the new players.
items.exampleCN: 一位教练指导了新队员。

items.meaning: to pile something in the way

definition_en: the process of building something, or the way something is put together
core_image: 围着绿色围栏的工地，塔吊在缓慢转动
scene: 街角的旧楼被围了起来，里面传出敲打声。The new library is still under construction.
sceneCN: 这里 construction 指「建造、施工」（第 1 个义项：把材料建成建筑的过程）；句意是新图书馆仍在施工中。

senses.title: The work of building
senses.definition: the process of putting materials together to make a building
senses.definitionCN: 把材料拼合成建筑的过程
senses.example: The bridge is still under construction.
senses.exampleCN: 这座桥仍在施工中。
senses.why: A site is a promise that is not finished yet.
senses.whyCN: 一个工地就是一个还没兑现的承诺。

senses.title: A built thing
senses.definition: a structure that has been built, often a large one
senses.definitionCN: 已经建成的结构物，常指较大的建筑
senses.example: The old construction beside the river was pulled down.
senses.exampleCN: 河边那座旧建筑被拆掉了。
senses.why: Once finished, the work becomes a thing with a shadow.
senses.whyCN: 活儿干完，就变成一个会投下影子的东西。

senses.title: The way parts fit
senses.definition: the arrangement of words or parts inside a whole
senses.definitionCN: 词语或部件在整体内部的排列方式
senses.example: The grammar book explains this construction clearly.
senses.exampleCN: 这本语法书把这个结构讲得很清楚。
senses.why: Sentences are also assembled, and their frames can be named.
senses.whyCN: 句子也是装配起来的，它们的架子也能被命名。

intro.en: Construction comes from Latin constructio, a piling together, from construere, to build up.
intro.cn: construction 来自拉丁语 constructio，意为堆在一起，源自 construere（建造）。

items.en: Struere meant to pile or lay in layers.
items.cn: struere 意为堆积或层层铺放。

items.en: Construere meant to pile materials into a building.
items.cn: construere 意为把材料堆成建筑。

items.en: Constructio named both building work and the fitting of words.
items.cn: constructio 同时指建造工作与词语的搭配。

items.en: French construction kept those two sides together.
items.cn: 法语 construction 把这两面保留在一起。

items.en: English construction first meant the act of building.
items.cn: 英语 construction 最初指建造的行为。

items.en: It now also means a structure and a grammatical pattern.
items.cn: 如今它也指建筑物与语法结构。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin pile base struct-, and the meaning group names other words for a built whole.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语堆积词基 struct-，近义组列出其他表示建成之物的词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a fenced site with a crane, then move to the finished building and to the frame inside a sentence.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从围起来的工地与塔吊开始，再到建成的楼房，最后到句子内部的架子。

normal.en: Con- is together and struct is pile, so construction is the act of piling parts together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，struct 是堆，construction 就是把部件堆到一起的行为。

normal.en: Under construction means the promise is still open.
normal.cn: 正在施工，意思是那个承诺还开着口。

normal.en: Every building is a construction, and so is every well-made sentence.
normal.cn: 每栋楼都是建造物，每个搭得好的句子也是。

normal.en: The crane turns, and the skyline changes by one beam.
normal.cn: 塔吊转一圈，天际线就多一根梁。

normal.en: Watch the frame, not the paint.
normal.cn: 看骨架，不要看油漆。

abstract.en: Picture a green fence around a hole in the ground.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈绿色围栏围着一个土坑。

abstract.en: Picture a crane lifting a beam against grey sky.
abstract.cn: 想象塔吊在灰天里吊起一根梁。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence drawn as a frame of boxes.
abstract.cn: 想象一个句子被画成一排方框的架子。

examples.en: The road is closed because of construction work.
examples.cn: 这条路因施工而封闭。

examples.en: A new hospital is under construction outside the city.
examples.cn: 城外正在建一所新医院。

examples.en: This construction appears often in formal writing.
examples.cn: 这个结构在正式写作中经常出现。

sensesIntro.en: From a site where a crane turns, to the building that finally stands, and to the frame hidden inside a sentence.

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fenced site where a crane lifts beam after beam.
core.cn: 核心意象：围起来的工地上，塔吊一根根吊起钢梁。

branches.en: The first sense is the noisy work that is not yet finished.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是尚未完工的、喧闹的活儿。

branches.en: The second sense is the thing that remains when the noise stops.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是噪音停下后留下的东西。

branches.en: The third sense is a frame of words rather than of steel.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是词语而非钢梁搭成的架子。

branches.en: Both senses point to the same site, one before and one after.
branches.cn: 两个义项指向同一个工地，一个在之前，一个在之后。

branches.en: A building and a sentence both hold their shape by design.

items.meaning: a person or thing that builds

items.example: The structure is made of steel.

definition_en: to ask someone for advice, or to look something up for information
core_image: 一个人拿着地图，向路边的老人问路
scene: 出发前，他先给当地的朋友打了个电话。You should consult a doctor before taking the pills.
sceneCN: 这里 consult 指「咨询、请教」（第 1 个义项：向人求取意见）；句意是吃药前你应当咨询医生。

senses.title: Ask for advice
senses.definition: to ask a person with knowledge for their opinion
senses.definitionCN: 向有知识的人征询意见
senses.example: Consult a doctor if the pain continues.
senses.exampleCN: 如果疼痛持续，请咨询医生。
senses.why: No one carries every answer, so some answers must be asked for.
senses.whyCN: 没人能带着所有答案，所以有些答案必须去问。

senses.title: Look it up
senses.definition: to search a book or record for information
senses.definitionCN: 在书本或记录中查找信息
senses.example: He consulted the map before setting out.
senses.exampleCN: 出发前他查了地图。
senses.why: A dictionary is advice that has been waiting quietly.
senses.whyCN: 词典是一份安静等候着的意见。

senses.title: Talk it over
senses.definition: to discuss something with others before deciding
senses.definitionCN: 做决定前与他人一起讨论
senses.example: The mayor consulted with local groups.
senses.exampleCN: 市长与当地团体进行了商议。
senses.why: A decision shared before it is made is harder to resent later.
senses.whyCN: 做决定前先商量，日后就不容易招怨。

intro.en: Consult comes from Latin consultare, to take counsel, a frequent form of consulere, to gather and deliberate.
intro.cn: consult 来自拉丁语 consultare，意为商议，是 consulere（聚集商议）的反复形式。

items.en: Consulere meant to gather people to deliberate.
items.cn: consulere 意为召集众人商议。

items.en: It also meant to look after the interests of someone.
items.cn: 它也指照看某人的利益。

items.en: Consultare repeated the act of asking for counsel.
items.cn: consultare 表示反复地征询意见。

items.en: French consulter carried the word into advice and books.
items.cn: 法语 consulter 把这个词带到求教与查书。

items.en: English consult meant to seek advice from a person.
items.cn: 英语 consult 指向人求教。

items.en: It now also covers checking a map, a file or a record.
items.cn: 如今它也指查地图、查档案或查记录。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin counsel base, and the meaning group names other verbs for seeking information or advice.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的商议词基，近义组列出其他表示求取信息或意见的动词。

normal.en: A map held open at a crossroads: that is consult.
normal.cn: 在十字路口摊开一张地图，那就是查阅。

normal.en: Ask before you act, and you have consulted.
normal.cn: 动手之前先问过，你就已经咨询过了。

normal.en: A dictionary is a quiet consultant on the shelf.
normal.cn: 词典是书架上一位安静的顾问。

normal.en: Two heads talking before one hand moves.
normal.cn: 两只脑袋先商量，一只手再行动。

abstract.en: Picture a finger running down a list of names.
abstract.cn: 想象一根手指顺着一列名字往下滑。

abstract.en: Picture a phone held to an ear in a hallway.
abstract.cn: 想象走廊里贴着耳朵的手机。

abstract.en: Picture a book opened flat beside a cold cup.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊平的书旁边放着一杯凉茶。

examples.en: You had better consult a specialist about the pain.
examples.cn: 关于这处疼痛，你最好咨询专科医生。

examples.en: She consulted the dictionary for the exact meaning.
examples.cn: 她查词典确认准确含义。

examples.en: The committee consulted with parents before changing the rules.
examples.cn: 委员会在修改规定前与家长进行了商议。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consult 记成 con（一起）加 sult（聚集）：把懂行的人聚到一起问个明白，就是咨询、请教。

root: 源自拉丁语 consultare（反复商议），本义是聚在一起商量，后指向人请教、查阅资料与共同商议。

sensesIntro.en: From a question put to an expert, to a fact hunted down in a book, and to people sitting together before a decision.
sensesIntro.cn: 从向专家提出的问题，到书里找出的一个事实，最后到决定前坐在一起的众人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone holding a map open, asking a stranger the way.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人摊开地图，向陌生人问路。

branches.en: The first sense is a question handed to someone who knows more.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是把问题交给懂得更多的人。

branches.en: The second sense asks a page instead of a person.
branches.cn: 第二个义项问的是一页纸，而不是一个人。

branches.en: The third sense puts several voices around one table.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把几个声音放到同一张桌子旁。

branches.en: Both senses go looking for knowledge outside the self.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是到自己之外去寻找知识。

branches.en: Advice and discussion both end in a better informed choice.
branches.cn: 请教与商议都以更知情的选择收尾。

intro.en: Consult is built on Latin con-, together, plus consulere, to gather and deliberate.
intro.cn: consult 由拉丁语 con-（一起）与 consulere（聚集商议）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin counsel base consult- also appears in consultant, consultation and consultative.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的商议词基 consult- 也出现在 consultant、consultation 与 consultative 中。

items.example: Consult the guide before you climb.

items.meaning: a person who gives expert advice
items.exampleCN: 他们请了一位税务顾问。

items.meaning: a meeting held to seek advice
items.exampleCN: 这次咨询持续了一小时。

items.example: The group has a consultative role.
items.exampleCN: 这个小组只承担咨询角色。

items.meaning: an official who looks after citizens abroad
items.meaningCN: 在海外照看本国公民的官员
items.example: The consul helped them replace their papers.
items.exampleCN: 领事帮他们补办了证件。

items.meaning: to leap at someone with rude words
items.example: He did not mean to insult her.
She sought counsel from an old teacher.

items.meaning: able to be looked up or asked
items.example: The archive is open and consultable.
items.exampleCN: 这批档案开放且可供查阅。

definition_en: a person who buys goods or services for their own use
core_image: 超市里推着购物车、逐件比较价签的人
scene: 超市里，一位顾客拿着两瓶洗衣液比价。Every consumer has the right to clear information.
sceneCN: 这里 consumer 指「消费者」（第 1 个义项：购买并使用商品的人）；句意是每位消费者都有权获得清楚的信息。

senses.title: A buyer of goods
senses.definition: a person who buys products or services for personal use
senses.definitionCN: 为个人使用而购买产品或服务的人
senses.example: Consumers are demanding clearer labels.
senses.exampleCN: 消费者正在要求更清楚的标签。
senses.why: One receipt is small, but millions of receipts decide a market.
senses.whyCN: 一张小票不起眼，千百万张小票却能决定市场。

senses.title: A user of a service
senses.definition: a person who uses a service, especially media or utilities
senses.definitionCN: 使用某项服务的人，尤指媒体或公用事业
senses.example: Energy consumers paid more this winter.
senses.exampleCN: 能源用户今年冬天付得更多。
senses.why: The word follows anyone who takes something in.
senses.whyCN: 凡是把东西接进来用的人，这个词都跟着他。

intro.en: Consumer is the agent noun of consume, from Latin consumere, to use up, with the ending -er marking the person.
intro.cn: consumer 是 consume 的行为者名词，源自拉丁语 consumere（用尽），词尾 -er 表示人。

items.en: Sumere meant to take, and consumere meant to take completely.
items.cn: sumere 意为拿取，consumere 意为彻底取走。

items.en: The noun described one who uses something up.
items.cn: 相应的名词指把东西用掉的人。

items.en: French consumer kept the sense of using and wasting.
items.cn: 法语 consumer 保留使用与耗掉的意思。

items.en: English consumer first meant one who wastes or destroys.
items.cn: 英语 consumer 最初指耗掉或毁掉东西的人。

items.en: Economics gave it the sense of a buyer of goods.
items.cn: 经济学赋予它商品购买者的含义。

items.en: It now covers buyers, users and media audiences.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖购买者、使用者与媒体受众。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the consume- family, and the meaning group names other people on the buying side.
note.cn: 形近组共享 consume- 词族，近义组列出买方一侧的其他角色。

entries.definition: to use up goods, fuel or time
the amount of something that is used
a person who buys from a particular shop
a person who buys something
a person who uses a product or service
a person or group that buys something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a shopping cart pushed down an aisle, then move to a hand comparing two price tags and to a bill paid at the door.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从推过货架的购物车开始，再到比较两个价签的那只手，最后到门口付掉的账单。

normal.en: Consume plus -er means the one who does the using up.
normal.cn: consume 加 -er，就是那个负责把东西用掉的人。

normal.en: A shopping cart is a consumer's small footprint.
normal.cn: 一辆购物车，就是消费者留下的小小脚印。

normal.en: The consumer pays, and the market listens.
normal.cn: 消费者掏钱，市场就听着。

normal.en: Every label is a promise made to a consumer.
normal.cn: 每一张标签，都是对消费者许下的承诺。

normal.en: One buyer is a person, many buyers are a force.
normal.cn: 一个买家是一个人，许多买家是一股力量。

abstract.en: Picture a hand turning a bottle to read the back label.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手转动瓶子去看背面的标签。

abstract.en: Picture a card tapped lightly on a small machine.
abstract.cn: 想象一张卡在小机器上轻轻一贴。

abstract.en: Picture a full trolley waiting at the checkout.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆装满的购物车在收银台前等候。

examples.en: Consumers are spending less on imported goods.
examples.cn: 消费者在进口商品上的花销减少了。

examples.en: The law protects consumers from false advertising.
examples.cn: 法律保护消费者免受虚假广告之害。

examples.en: Cheap packaging appeals to many consumers.
examples.cn: 简易包装对许多消费者有吸引力。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consumer 记成 consume（消耗）加 er（人）：把商品买回去用掉的人，就是消费者。

root: 由 consume（用尽、消耗）加人称词尾 -er 构成，词根为拉丁语 consumere（彻底取走），后指购买并使用商品的消费者与用户。

sensesIntro.en: From the person pushing a cart, to the household that pays an energy bill.
sensesIntro.cn: 从推着购物车的人，到支付能源账单的那户人家。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shopper comparing two bottles under a bright shelf.
core.cn: 核心意象：明亮的货架下，一位顾客比较着两个瓶子。

branches.en: The first sense is the person who buys with money.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是用钱买东西的人。

branches.en: The second sense widens to anyone who uses a service.
branches.cn: 第二个义项扩大到任何使用服务的人。

branches.en: Both senses describe the last link before a product is used.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述产品被使用前的最后一环。

branches.en: Prices and labels are written for the buyer's eye.
branches.cn: 价格与标签都是写给买家的眼睛看的。

branches.en: A service consumer can complain, switch or simply leave.
branches.cn: 服务用户可以抱怨、更换，或者干脆离开。

intro.en: Consumer is consume plus the person ending -er, from Latin consumere, to use up.
intro.cn: consumer 是 consume 加人称词尾 -er，源自拉丁语 consumere（用尽）。

latinIntro.en: The Latin take base sum- also appears in assumption, resumption and presumption.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的拿取词基 sum- 也出现在 assumption、resumption 与 presumption 中。

items.meaning: a person who uses up goods
items.exampleCN: 那位消费者留下了小票。

items.example: The car consumes a lot of fuel.

items.meaning: a culture of buying more and more
items.example: Critics blame consumerism for the waste.
items.exampleCN: 批评者把浪费归咎于消费主义。

items.meaningCN: 支持以消费为中心的生活的
items.exampleCN: 他们拒绝消费主义的生活方式。

items.example: We assume prices will stay low.
items.exampleCN: 我们假定价格会保持低位。

items.meaning: to take an activity up again
items.example: The shop resumed trading on Monday.

items.meaningCN: 预先认定某事可能如此

definition_en: the act of using up fuel, food, energy or time, or the amount that is used
core_image: 水表数字不断跳动，一格一格往上走
scene: 工厂的用电数字每个季度都在往上爬。Energy consumption rose sharply last winter.
sceneCN: 这里 consumption 指「消耗量」（第 1 个义项：实际用掉的能源或物资数量）；句意是去年冬天能源消耗量急剧上升。

senses.title: The amount used
senses.definition: the measured amount of fuel, food or energy that is used
senses.definitionCN: 被用掉的燃料、食物或能量的计量数值
senses.example: Fuel consumption fell after the new engine arrived.
senses.exampleCN: 换了新发动机后油耗下降了。
senses.why: What cannot be seen can still be counted on a meter.
senses.whyCN: 看不见的东西，也能在表上被数清。

senses.title: Buying and using
senses.definition: the economic activity of buying and using goods and services
senses.definitionCN: 购买并使用商品与服务的经济活动
senses.example: Household consumption drives half the economy.
senses.exampleCN: 家庭消费支撑着经济的一半。
senses.why: An economy is a circle, and spending keeps it turning.
senses.whyCN: 经济是一个圆圈，花销让它转起来。

senses.title: A wasting illness
senses.definition: an old name for tuberculosis, a disease that wastes the body away
senses.definitionCN: 肺结核的旧称，一种使身体日渐消瘦的病
senses.example: In the last century, consumption was often fatal.
senses.exampleCN: 在上个世纪，痨病常常致命。
senses.why: A disease that consumes the body borrowed the same word.
senses.whyCN: 一种把身体耗掉的病，借用了同一个词。

intro.en: Consumption comes from Latin consumptio, a using up, from consumere, to take completely.
intro.cn: consumption 来自拉丁语 consumptio，意为用尽，源自 consumere（彻底取走）。

items.en: Sumere meant to take, and consumere meant to take completely.
items.cn: sumere 意为拿取，consumere 意为彻底取走。

items.en: Consumptio named the act of using something up.
items.cn: consumptio 指把东西用掉的行为。

items.en: Medical writers used it for a body wasting away.
items.cn: 医学作者用它指身体日渐消瘦。

items.en: French consumption carried both the spending and the illness senses.
items.cn: 法语中的这个词同时带有耗费与疾病两层意思。

items.en: English consumption first meant the using up of things.
items.cn: 英语 consumption 最初指物品被用尽。

items.en: Economics made it the standard term for spending on goods.
items.cn: 经济学使它成为商品花销的标准术语。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin take base sumpt-, and the meaning group names other words for the using of resources.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语拿取词基 sumpt-，近义组列出其他表示资源使用的词。
