normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a meter climbing, then move to a family filling a cart and to an old illness that empties a body.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从往上爬的计量表开始，再到把购物车装满的一家人，最后到一种把身体掏空的旧病。

normal.en: Consumption is consume turned into a noun you can measure.
normal.cn: consumption 是 consume 变成可以测量的名词。

normal.en: A meter that keeps climbing is consumption made visible.
normal.cn: 一只不断往上爬的表，就是把消耗变得看得见。

normal.en: Every cart leaving a shop adds to consumption.
normal.cn: 每一辆推出店门的购物车，都在给消费加数。

normal.en: Fuel consumption is a number a driver can lower.
normal.cn: 油耗是司机能压低的一个数字。

normal.en: What is consumed today is gone tomorrow.
normal.cn: 今天被消耗掉的东西，明天就没有了。

abstract.en: Picture digits turning over on a water meter.
abstract.cn: 想象水表上的数字一格格翻过去。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of receipts growing on a desk.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上的小票越堆越高。

abstract.en: Picture a candle burning shorter every hour.
abstract.cn: 想象一根蜡烛每小时都短一截。

examples.en: Water consumption doubles in the hot months.
examples.cn: 炎热月份的用水量会翻倍。

examples.en: The government wants to cut energy consumption by a third.
examples.cn: 政府想把能源消耗削减三分之一。

examples.en: Rising consumption usually means a stronger economy.
examples.cn: 消费上升通常意味着经济更强。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 consumption 记成 consume（消耗）加 ption（名词）：把东西彻底用掉这件事，就是消耗，也用来说消耗量。

root: 源自拉丁语 consumptio（用尽），词根 consumere 由 com（彻底）与 sumere（拿取）构成，后指消耗量、消费与旧时所说痨病。

sensesIntro.en: From digits on a meter, to the spending of a whole economy, and at last to an old name for a wasting disease.
sensesIntro.cn: 从表上的数字，到整个经济的花销，最后到一种消耗身体的旧病名称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a meter whose digits keep climbing upward.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只数字不断向上爬的计量表。

branches.en: The first sense is a figure you can read and compare.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是能读出来、能比较的数字。

branches.en: The second sense is the whole economy's habit of buying.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是整个经济的购买习惯。

branches.en: The third sense is a body using itself up.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是一个身体把自己耗掉。

branches.en: Both senses track how much passes from shelf to use.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在追踪有多少东西从货架走到使用。

branches.en: A meter and a disease both record a steady loss.
branches.cn: 计量表与疾病都记录着持续的减少。

intro.en: Consumption is built on Latin com-, completely, plus sumere, to take, with the noun ending -ption.
intro.cn: consumption 由拉丁语 com-（彻底）、sumere（拿取）与名词词尾 -ption 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin take base sumpt- also appears in assumption, resumption and presumption.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的拿取词基 sumpt- 也出现在 assumption、resumption 与 presumption 中。

items.meaning: the using up of goods or energy
to take something until it is gone
items.example: The old boiler consumes too much gas.

items.meaning: a person who buys and uses goods
items.exampleCN: 消费者想要更低的价格。

items.example: The plan rests on a false assumption.
items.exampleCN: 这个计划建立在一个错误假定上。

items.example: The resumption of talks was welcome.

items.meaning: to place one thing under a larger class
items.meaningCN: 把一物归入更大的类别
items.example: The term subsumes many local names.
items.exampleCN: 这个术语涵盖了许多地方名称。

definition_en: the state of touching, communication with someone, or a person you can reach
core_image: 两只手在桌面上握到一起
scene: 飞机落地后，她第一时间给家里发了消息。Please contact me when you arrive.
sceneCN: 这里 contact 指「联系」（第 1 个义项：与人取得沟通）；句意是你到了以后请与我联系。

senses.title: Getting in touch
senses.definition: the act of communicating with someone by message, call or meeting
senses.definitionCN: 通过消息、电话或见面与人沟通的行为
senses.example: We kept in contact after the course ended.
senses.exampleCN: 课程结束后我们仍保持联系。
senses.why: Two people can touch across a city with one short message.
senses.whyCN: 两个人靠一条短信，就能跨过一座城相触。

senses.title: Physical touching
senses.definition: the state of two things or surfaces being in touch
senses.definitionCN: 两个物体或表面相互挨着的状态
senses.example: Wash your hands after contact with the soil.
senses.exampleCN: 接触土壤后要洗手。
senses.why: The oldest sense is still the simplest: two surfaces meet.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项仍然最简单：两个表面碰上了。

senses.title: A person to reach
senses.definition: a person you know who can give help or information
senses.definitionCN: 能提供帮助或信息的熟人
senses.example: She has a contact inside the ministry.
senses.exampleCN: 她在部里有一个联络人。
senses.why: A useful name in a notebook is a door that opens later.
senses.whyCN: 笔记本里一个有用的名字，是日后会打开的门。

intro.en: Contact comes from Latin contactus, a touching, from contingere, built on com-, together, and tangere, to touch.
intro.cn: contact 来自拉丁语 contactus（接触），源自动词 contingere，由 com-（一起）与 tangere（触碰）构成。

items.en: Tangere meant to touch or reach a thing.
items.cn: tangere 意为触碰或触及某物。

items.en: Contingere meant to touch together or come into contact.
items.cn: contingere 意为碰到一起或发生接触。

items.en: Contactus named the state of touching.
items.cn: contactus 指相互接触的状态。

items.en: French contact carried the word into social and scientific use.
items.cn: 法语 contact 把这个词带进社交与科学语境。

items.en: English contact first meant physical touching.
items.cn: 英语 contact 最初指身体上的接触。

items.en: Telegraphs and phones added the sense of staying in touch.
items.cn: 电报与电话为它添上了保持联络的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin touch base tact-, and the meaning group names other words for a link between people.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语触碰词基 tact-，近义组列出其他表示人际连接的说法。

entries.definition: a written agreement between two sides
complete and not damaged
relating to the sense of touch
the act of putting a hand on something
the sharing of information between people
a link between people or things

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from two hands meeting on a table, then move to a message crossing a city and to a useful name in a notebook.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从桌面上两只手相握开始，再到一条穿过城市的信息，最后到笔记本里一个有用的名字。

normal.en: Con- is together and tact is touch, so contact is touching together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tact 是触碰，contact 就是一起碰上。

normal.en: A handshake is the oldest form of contact.
normal.cn: 握手是最古老的接触方式。

normal.en: A phone call is touch without hands.
normal.cn: 一通电话，是不用手的触碰。

normal.en: Keep the number, and you keep a door.
normal.cn: 留住号码，就留住一扇门。

normal.en: Contact begins where distance ends.
normal.cn: 距离结束的地方，联系就开始了。

abstract.en: Picture two hands meeting across a wooden table.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在木桌上方握到一起。

abstract.en: Picture a name written on the back of a card.
abstract.cn: 想象一个名字写在卡片背面。

abstract.en: Picture a thin line drawn between two distant dots.
abstract.cn: 想象两个遥远的点之间画着一条细线。

examples.en: Please contact the office if your plans change.
examples.cn: 如果你的计划有变，请联系办公室。

examples.en: The two wires must not be in contact.
examples.cn: 这两根电线不得接触。

examples.en: He gave me the contact for a good translator.
examples.cn: 他给了我一位好译者的联系方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contact 记成 con（一起）加 tact（触碰）：两方碰到一起，无论是手还是消息，都是联系。

root: 源自拉丁语 contactus（接触），动词 contingere 由 com（一起）与 tangere（触碰）构成，本义是碰到一起，后指沟通联系与联络人。

sensesIntro.en: From two surfaces meeting, to voices reaching across a city, and to a name kept for a future need.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两个表面相碰，到声音跨过城市抵达，最后到为日后需要而留下的一个名字。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands meeting on a table top.
core.cn: 核心意象：桌面之上，两只手相握。

branches.en: The first sense is a message that reaches its person.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是抵达对方的消息。

branches.en: The second sense is the plain meeting of two surfaces.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是两个表面朴素的相碰。

branches.en: The third sense turns the link into a person with a name.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把这条连接变成一个有名字的人。

branches.en: Both senses depend on someone willing to answer.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个愿意回应的人。

branches.en: A handshake and a phone call both begin with contact.
branches.cn: 握手与通话都从接触开始。

intro.en: Contact is built on Latin com-, together, plus tangere, to touch, whose participle base is tact-.
intro.cn: contact 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tangere（触碰）构成，其分词词基为 tact-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin touch base tact- also appears in tactile, tangible and contagious.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的触碰词基 tact- 也出现在 tactile、tangible 与 contagious 中。

items.meaning: a touching together or a link
items.exampleCN: 搬家后他们失去了联系。

items.meaningCN: 无需实体接触即可工作
items.example: She paid with a contactless card.

items.exampleCN: 可以通过电子邮件联系到他。
这个孩子喜欢有触感的玩具。

items.meaning: able to be touched or felt
items.example: There was a tangible change in mood.
items.exampleCN: 气氛有了可以感觉到的变化。

items.meaning: spreading by touch or near contact
not touched, so whole and undamaged
items.meaningCN: 未被碰过，因而完整无损

items.meaning: an agreement drawn tight between sides

definition_en: to have something inside, or to keep something under control
core_image: 一只箱子把里面的东西全兜住，一点不外漏
scene: 她打开信封，里面是一张折好的地图。This box contains all the old letters.
sceneCN: 这里 contain 指「装有、包含」（第 1 个义项：内部盛有某物）；句意是这只箱子里装着所有旧信件。

senses.title: Have inside
senses.definition: to have something inside or as a part
senses.definitionCN: 内部盛有某物，或把某物作为一部分
senses.example: The letter contains a short apology.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信里有一句简短的道歉。
senses.why: A shell is interesting mainly for what it keeps.
senses.whyCN: 一个外壳之所以值得一提，主要看它装着什么。

senses.title: Have room for
senses.definition: to be able to hold a certain amount
senses.definitionCN: 能够装下一定的数量
senses.example: This bottle contains two litres.
senses.exampleCN: 这个瓶子能装两升。
senses.why: Every container has a limit it never tells you out loud.
senses.whyCN: 每个容器都有一个它不会开口说的限度。

senses.title: Keep under control
senses.definition: to stop something from spreading or showing
senses.definitionCN: 阻止某事物扩散或显露出来
senses.example: Firefighters contained the fire before midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 消防员在午夜前控制住了火势。
senses.why: The same word that holds water can hold back fear.
senses.whyCN: 兜住水的那同一个词，也能兜住恐惧。

intro.en: Contain comes from Latin continere, to hold together, built from com-, together, and tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: contain 来自拉丁语 continere，意为握在一起，由 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

items.en: Tenere meant to hold in the hand or keep.
items.cn: tenere 意为握在手中或守住。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together inside.
items.cn: continere 意为把东西拢在里面。

items.en: It also meant to keep feelings or crowds in check.
items.cn: 它也指把情绪或人群约束住。

items.en: French contenir carried the holding sense into use.
items.cn: 法语 contenir 把盛装的含义带入使用。

items.en: English contain first meant to hold within limits.
items.cn: 英语 contain 最初指在界限内盛住。

items.en: It now covers both holding things and holding back danger.
items.cn: 如今它既指盛装物品，也指遏制危险。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin hold base ten-, and the meaning group names other verbs for having something inside.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语握持词基 ten-，近义组列出其他表示内部含有的动词。

entries.definition: an object made to hold things
what is inside something
to keep something in good condition
to have something inside or in your hand
to have something as one of its parts
to be made up of particular parts

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a closed box, then move to a bottle with a fixed limit and to a fire held inside a line.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只合上的箱子开始，再到一个有固定容量的瓶子，最后到被拦在一条线里的火。

normal.en: Con- is together and tain is hold, so contain is holding things together inside.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tain 是握住，contain 就是把东西拢在里面。

normal.en: A box contains, a bottle contains, a good speaker contains nerves.
normal.cn: 箱子装着东西，瓶子装着水，好的演讲者装着紧张。

normal.en: Contain is a wall; include is a welcome.
normal.cn: contain 是一道墙，include 是一声欢迎。

normal.en: The lid is closed, and the story stays inside.
normal.cn: 盖子合上，故事就留在里面。

normal.en: To contain a fire is to give it nowhere to go.
normal.cn: 控制一场火，就是让它无处可去。

abstract.en: Picture a closed tin on a high shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象高处架子上的一只合上的铁盒。

abstract.en: Picture a jar filled exactly to the line.
abstract.cn: 想象一只刚好装到刻线的罐子。

abstract.en: Picture a rope line stopping a crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一条绳线拦住人群。

examples.en: The report contains several useful charts.
examples.cn: 这份报告里有几张有用的图表。

examples.en: This drink contains no sugar at all.
examples.cn: 这种饮料完全不含糖。

examples.en: Doctors worked fast to contain the infection.
examples.cn: 医生迅速行动以控制感染。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contain 记成 con（一起）加 tain（握住）：把东西一起握在壳里，就是包含、容纳。

root: 源自拉丁语 continere（com 一起 + tenere 握住），本义是把东西拢在一起，后指包含、容纳与把危险或情绪控制住。

sensesIntro.en: From what a box keeps inside, to the amount a bottle can hold, and to a fire stopped at a line.
sensesIntro.cn: 从箱子里装着的东西，到瓶子能装的量，最后到被拦在一条线上的火。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a closed box with everything held inside its walls.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只合上的箱子，东西都被兜在四壁之内。

branches.en: The first sense is simply what the walls enclose.
branches.cn: 第一个义项就是四壁围住的东西。

branches.en: The second sense is the size of the space inside.
branches.cn: 第二个义项是内部空间的大小。

branches.en: The third sense keeps something from getting out.
branches.cn: 第三个义项是让某物跑不出去。

branches.en: Both senses are about an inside that has a limit.
branches.cn: 两个义项都关于一个有界限的内部。

branches.en: A space with limits can also limit a danger.
branches.cn: 有界限的空间，也能限制危险。

intro.en: Contain is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: contain 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin hold base ten-/tain- also appears in maintain, obtain and retain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的握持词基 ten-/tain- 也出现在 maintain、obtain 与 retain 中。

items.meaning: a thing made to hold other things
items.example: Put the rice in a container.

items.meaning: the act of keeping something in
items.meaningCN: 把某物限制在内的行为
items.example: The containment of the leak took hours.
items.exampleCN: 控制泄漏花了几个小时。

items.meaning: able to be kept under control
to keep holding in good state
items.meaningCN: 持续握住并保持良好状态
items.exampleCN: 他们把这条路养护得很好。

items.example: She obtained a copy of the file.
items.exampleCN: 她拿到了文件的一份副本。

definition_zh: 当代的；同时代的；同时代的人
definition_en: belonging to the present time, or existing at the same time as something else
core_image: 一间摆着现代家具和旧木梁的屋子，两个时代并排
scene: 美术馆的一层正在展出当下艺术家的作品。The museum has a whole floor of contemporary art.
sceneCN: 这里 contemporary 指「当代的」（第 1 个义项：属于当下这个时代）；句意是这家美术馆有整整一层当代艺术。

senses.title: Of the present age
senses.definition: belonging to the time we live in now
senses.definitionCN: 属于我们现在生活的这个时代
senses.example: She collects contemporary paintings.
senses.exampleCN: 她收藏当代绘画。
senses.why: Every age calls itself the present, and means it.
senses.whyCN: 每个时代都把自己叫作当下，而且说得很真诚。

senses.title: Of the same time
senses.definition: existing or happening in the same period as something else
senses.definitionCN: 与另一事物存在于同一个时期
senses.example: These two buildings are contemporary with each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两座建筑属于同一时代。
senses.why: Two things can share a century without ever meeting.
senses.whyCN: 两件事可以共处一个世纪，却从未相遇。

senses.title: A person of the same age
senses.definition: a person who lived or worked at the same time as another
senses.definitionCN: 与另一人同时生活或工作的人
senses.example: He was a contemporary of the young Mozart.
senses.exampleCN: 他是青年莫扎特的同时代人。
senses.why: History is easier to see beside someone who stood next to it.
senses.whyCN: 历史若挨着一个曾站在旁边的人来看，会清楚些。

intro.en: Contemporary comes from Latin contemporarius, built from com-, together, and tempus, time.
intro.cn: contemporary 来自拉丁语 contemporarius，由 com-（一起）与 tempus（时间）构成。

items.en: Tempus meant time or a period of time.
items.cn: tempus 意为时间或一段时期。

items.en: Contemporarius meant sharing the same time.
items.cn: contemporarius 意为共处同一时间。

items.en: It described events and people of one period.
items.cn: 它用来描述同一时期的事件与人物。

items.en: French contemporain carried both the present and the same-time senses.
items.cn: 法语 contemporain 同时带有当下与同时两层意思。

items.en: English contemporary first meant living at the same time.
items.cn: 英语 contemporary 最初指生活在同一时期。

items.en: It now usually points to art and culture of our own day.
items.cn: 如今它通常指我们这一天的艺术与文化。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin time base tempor-, and the meaning group names other words for what belongs to now.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语时间词基 tempor-，近义组列出其他表示「属于现在」的词。

entries.definition: lasting only for a short time
happening in the same period
the speed at which music is played
relating to the present or recent times
happening or existing now
existing at this moment

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a room where new chairs stand under old beams, then move to two lives sharing one century.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从新椅子摆在旧木梁下的房间开始，再到共享一个世纪的两个人。

normal.en: Con- is together and tempor is time, so contemporary is sharing one time.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tempor 是时间，contemporary 就是共处同一时间。

normal.en: Contemporary art is the art of the room you are standing in.
normal.cn: 当代艺术，就是你此刻站着的那间屋子里的艺术。

normal.en: Two painters of one year are contemporaries, even if they never met.
normal.cn: 同一年份的两位画家就是同时代人，哪怕从未见过。

normal.en: Temporary lasts a while; contemporary means this while.
normal.cn: temporary 是持续一阵子，contemporary 指的是眼下这一阵。

normal.en: Every era thinks it is the final one.
normal.cn: 每个时代都以为自己是最后一个。

abstract.en: Picture old wooden beams above a clean new table.
abstract.cn: 想象旧木梁下面一张干净的新桌子。

abstract.en: Picture two calendars hanging side by side.
abstract.cn: 想象两本日历并排挂着。

abstract.en: Picture a gallery wall lit by a single lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象画廊的一面墙被一盏灯照亮。

examples.en: The gallery shows contemporary Chinese painting.
examples.cn: 这家画廊展出中国当代绘画。

examples.en: The poet was a contemporary of Shakespeare.
examples.cn: 这位诗人是莎士比亚的同时代人。

examples.en: Contemporary life moves faster than it did a century ago.
examples.cn: 当代生活比一个世纪前快得多。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contemporary 记成 con（一起）加 tempor（时间）加 ary：和你共享同一段时间的，就是同时代的、当代的。

root: 源自拉丁语 contemporarius（com 一起 + tempus 时间），本义是共处同一时间，后指当代的、同时代的与同时代的人。

sensesIntro.en: From the art of our own day, to two lives in one century, and to the person who stood beside a famous name.
sensesIntro.cn: 从我们这一天的艺术，到同一个世纪里的两段人生，最后到站在名人身边的那个人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a modern chair standing under an old timber beam.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把现代椅子立在旧木梁之下。

branches.en: The first sense points at the culture being made right now.
branches.cn: 第一个义项指向此刻正在被创造的文化。

branches.en: The second sense lines two things up in one period.
branches.cn: 第二个义项把两件事排进同一个时期。

branches.en: The third sense turns the period into a person.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把一段时期变成一个人。

branches.en: Both senses depend on a clock everyone agrees about.
branches.cn: 两个义项都依赖一个人人都认的时钟。

branches.en: A contemporary is a witness who happened to share the years.
branches.cn: 同时代人就是一个恰好共享那些年份的见证者。

intro.en: Contemporary is built on Latin com-, together, plus tempus, time, with the ending -ary.
intro.cn: contemporary 由拉丁语 com-（一起）、tempus（时间）与词尾 -ary 构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin time base tempor- also appears in temporary, tempo and temporal.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的时间词基 tempor- 也出现在 temporary、tempo 与 temporal 中。

items.exampleCN: 这两位作家是同时代人。
这两份记录属于同一时期。

items.meaning: in the manner of the present time
items.exampleCN: 这座大厅采用了当代风格。

items.meaning: the speed of a piece of music
items.example: The tempo slowed near the end.
items.exampleCN: 曲子在结尾处慢了下来。

items.meaning: relating to time or worldly life
items.meaningCN: 与时间或世俗生活有关的
items.example: The essay deals with temporal change.
items.exampleCN: 这篇文章讨论时间中的变化。

items.meaning: to delay in order to gain time
spoken without preparation, on the spot
items.meaningCN: 当场说出而未经准备的

definition_en: what is inside or written in something, or feeling happy and satisfied
core_image: 翻开一本书，满页的字与图铺在眼前
scene: 她翻到目录，看这本书到底讲了哪些章节。The content of the report surprised everyone.
sceneCN: 这里 content 指「内容」（第 1 个义项：书或文件里写的东西）；句意是这份报告的内容让所有人吃惊。

senses.title: What is written or shown
senses.definition: the ideas, words or images held in a book, film or site
senses.definitionCN: 书、影片或网站里承载的想法、文字或图像
senses.example: The content of the letter was short but clear.
senses.exampleCN: 这封信的内容简短而清楚。
senses.why: A cover tells you nothing about what it protects.
senses.whyCN: 封面对于它所保护的东西一无所知。

senses.title: The amount inside
senses.definition: the amount of a substance held in something
senses.definitionCN: 某物内部所含某种物质的量
senses.example: Check the sugar content on the label.
senses.exampleCN: 看看标签上的含糖量。
senses.why: What a thing is made of can be printed as a number.
senses.whyCN: 一件东西由什么构成，能印成一个数字。

senses.title: Quietly satisfied
senses.definition: happy with what one has and not wanting more
senses.definitionCN: 对已有的事物满意而不求更多
senses.example: She felt content with her small garden.
senses.exampleCN: 她对自己那片小花园感到满足。
senses.why: The word that means held together also means at rest.
senses.whyCN: 表示「拢在一起」的那个词，也表示安心。

intro.en: Content comes from Latin contentus, the past participle of continere, held together, and so also satisfied.
intro.cn: content 来自拉丁语 contentus，是 continere（拢住）的过去分词，因而也含有「被满足」之意。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together inside.
items.cn: continere 意为把东西拢在里面。

items.en: Contentus described something contained, and later a mind at rest.
items.cn: contentus 描述被容纳之物，后来也指安定的心。

items.en: The noun named what a thing held within it.
items.cn: 相应的名词指事物内部所盛的东西。

items.en: French content kept both the inside and the satisfied senses.
items.cn: 法语 content 同时保留内部与满足两层意思。

items.en: English content first meant what a writing held.
items.cn: 英语 content 最初指文字作品所包含的东西。

items.en: It now covers media material and the amount of a substance.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖媒体素材与某种物质的含量。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the contain- family, and the meaning group names other words for what fills a thing or a mind.
note.cn: 形近组共享 contain- 词族，近义组列出其他表示充盈之物或满足之情的词。

entries.definition: the things held inside something
to have something inside
feeling happy and satisfied
pleased because a need or wish is met
entries.definitionCN: 因需求得到满足而高兴的

entries.definition: the material that something is made of
facts or things used to make something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from a page full of print, then move to a number on a label and to a person who wants nothing more.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从印满字的书页开始，再到标签上的一个数字，最后到一个别无所求的人。

normal.en: Content is what a container holds, moved from things to words.
normal.cn: content 就是容器里的东西，从实物挪到了文字上。

normal.en: A thick cover hides a thin content, or a rich one.
normal.cn: 厚封面既可能盖着单薄的内容，也可能盖着丰富的内涵。

normal.en: Sugar content is content you can measure in grams.
normal.cn: 含糖量是能用克称出来的内容。

normal.en: To be content is to have enough and stop counting.
normal.cn: 满足就是觉得够了，不再往下数。

normal.en: The same word fills a book and calms a heart.
normal.cn: 同一个词既装满一本书，也安顿一颗心。

abstract.en: Picture an open book with dense small print.
abstract.cn: 想象一本摊开的书，满是细密的字。

abstract.en: Picture a label with one number circled.
abstract.cn: 想象一张标签上有一个被圈出的数字。

abstract.en: Picture a person sitting still with a cup of tea.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人端着一杯茶静静坐着。

examples.en: The content of the course is mostly practical.
examples.cn: 这门课的内容大多是实用的。

examples.en: This juice has a high sugar content.
examples.cn: 这种果汁含糖量很高。

examples.en: He was content to wait another hour.
examples.cn: 他愿意再等一个小时。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 content 记成 con（一起）加 tent（握住）：被一起握住、兜在里面的东西就是内容，兜得刚好就叫满足。

root: 源自拉丁语 contentus（continere 拢住 的过去分词），本义是被盛住、被围住，后指容器里的内容、物质的含量，又引申为内心安定的满足。

sensesIntro.en: From the words held inside a cover, to the grams held in a bottle, and to a heart that holds enough.
sensesIntro.cn: 从封面里装着的文字，到瓶子里装着的克数，最后到一颗装得下「够了」的心。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an open book whose pages are packed with print.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本摊开的书，书页上排满文字。

branches.en: The first sense is everything the cover keeps from view.
branches.cn: 第一个义项是封面挡在视线之外的一切。

branches.en: The second sense weighs the inside in grams.
branches.cn: 第二个义项用克来称里面的东西。

branches.en: The third sense says a person can also be full and at rest.
branches.cn: 第三个义项说人也能装满而安歇。

branches.en: Both senses ask what a thing is carrying inside it.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在问一件东西里面装着什么。

branches.en: Enough sugar and enough peace are both a kind of measure.
branches.cn: 足够的糖与足够的安宁，都是一种度量。

intro.en: Content is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold: what is held inside.
intro.cn: content 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成，指被拢在里面的东西。

latinIntro.en: The Latin hold base tent- also appears in contain, retention and maintain.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语的握持词基 tent- 也出现在 contain、retention 与 maintain 中。

items.meaningCN: 被拢在某物里面的东西
items.example: The content of the box was a mystery.
items.exampleCN: 盒子里装的是什么仍是个谜。

items.meaning: the list or the things inside
items.example: She checked the contents of the bag.
The cat looked contented by the fire.
items.exampleCN: 那只猫在炉火边显得很满足。

items.meaning: the state of wanting nothing more
items.example: A simple meal gave him contentment.
items.exampleCN: 一顿简单的饭就让他很知足。

items.meaning: an object that holds other things

definition_zh: 比赛；竞赛；争夺；对…提出异议
definition_en: an event in which people compete, or to compete for something or argue against it
core_image: 两方站在同一块场地上，盯着同一枚奖牌
scene: 报名表贴出后，两个班级都想拿到唯一的决赛名额。Our class will contest the final against theirs.
sceneCN: 这里 contest 指「争夺」（第 2 个义项：为赢得某物而竞争）；句意是我们班将和他们班争夺决赛资格。

senses.title: A competition
senses.definition: an organized event in which people try to win by being better than others
senses.definitionCN: 人们通过胜过他人来取胜的有组织的活动
senses.example: She won the singing contest.
senses.exampleCN: 她在歌唱比赛中获胜。
senses.why: A prize means little unless someone else also wanted it.
senses.whyCN: 奖品若无人相争，也就不值什么。

senses.title: A struggle to win
senses.definition: an effort by rivals to gain the same thing
senses.definitionCN: 对手为得到同一事物而进行的较量
senses.example: Both sides contest the empty seat.
senses.exampleCN: 双方都在争夺这个空出的席位。
senses.why: Two hands reaching for one object is the oldest picture of rivalry.
senses.whyCN: 两只手伸向同一样东西，就是竞争最古老的画面。

senses.title: To call into question
senses.definition: to argue formally that a decision is wrong or unfair
senses.definitionCN: 正式指出某个决定有误或不公
senses.example: They decided to contest the fine.
senses.exampleCN: 他们决定对这笔罚款提出异议。
senses.why: To stand against a ruling is also a kind of match.
senses.whyCN: 站出来反对一项裁决，也是一场比赛。

intro.en: Contest comes from Latin contestari, to call witnesses and begin a lawsuit, built from com-, together, and testis, a witness.
intro.cn: contest 来自拉丁语 contestari，意为召集证人、提起诉讼，由 com-（一起）与 testis（证人）构成。

items.en: Testis meant a witness, the person who stands beside a case.
items.cn: testis 意为证人，即站在案子旁边的人。

items.en: Contestari meant to call witnesses and open a dispute in court.
items.cn: contestari 意为召集证人、在法庭上开始争讼。

items.en: The verb widened to mean arguing against any claim.
items.cn: 这个词义扩大为对任何主张进行争辩。

items.en: Old French conteste named a quarrel or a dispute.
items.cn: 古法语 conteste 指争吵或争执。

items.en: English contest first meant a dispute, then a trial of skill.
items.cn: 英语 contest 先指争辩，后指技艺的较量。

items.en: Today the noun usually means an organized competition.
items.cn: 今天名词通常指有组织的比赛。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin witness base test-, and the meaning group names other kinds of competition.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的证人词基 test-，近义组列出其他表示竞争的说法。

entries.definition: a person who takes part in a competition
a strong statement that something is wrong
a formal statement given as evidence
a situation in which people try to win the same thing
a sports event between two sides
a lasting competition between people

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two sides under one test, then move to the fight for a single prize and to a ruling being challenged.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从两方同受一场检验开始，再到争夺同一个奖品，最后到对裁决提出异议。

normal.en: Con- is together and test is the test, so a contest is two sides tested together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，test 是检验，contest 就是两方一同受检验。

normal.en: One prize and two pairs of hands: the word is already in the room.
normal.cn: 一个奖品，两双手：这个词已经在房间里了。

normal.en: A judge says a name, and one side smiles while the other argues.
normal.cn: 裁判念出一个名字，一方笑了，另一方开始争辩。

normal.en: The noun is the match, the verb is the reach for the prize.
normal.cn: 名词是那场比赛，动词是伸手去够奖品。

normal.en: A good contest leaves both sides knowing more than before.
normal.cn: 一场好的比赛，让双方都比从前知道得更多。

abstract.en: Picture two runners leaning at the same white line.
abstract.cn: 想象两名跑者在同一条白线上倾身。

abstract.en: Picture two hands closing on one medal at once.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手同时抓住同一枚奖牌。

abstract.en: Picture a raised hand in a hall, asking the ruling to be heard again.
abstract.cn: 想象会场里举起一只手，要求重新审议裁决。

examples.en: More than fifty singers entered the contest.
examples.cn: 五十多名歌手报名参加了这场比赛。

examples.en: She decided to contest the result in court.
examples.cn: 她决定在法庭上对结果提出异议。

examples.en: Two teams will contest the cup on Sunday.
examples.cn: 两支球队将在周日争夺奖杯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contest 记成 con（一起）加 test（检验）：两人一起接受检验，就是比赛与争夺。

root: 源自拉丁语 contestari（召集证人、提起诉讼），由 con-（一起）与 testis（证人）构成，后引申为争辩、争夺与比赛。

sensesIntro.en: From two sides tested against each other, to the reach for one prize, and at last to a ruling being challenged.
sensesIntro.cn: 从两方互相较量，到伸手够同一个奖品，最后到对裁决提出异议。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two runners leaning for the same finish line.
core.cn: 核心意象：两名跑者朝同一条终点线倾身。

branches.en: An organized event puts skill on show.
branches.cn: 有组织的活动把本领摆到台面上。

branches.en: The verb names the reach for the same object.
branches.cn: 动词点出伸向同一件东西的手。

branches.en: The oldest sense still lives in a court challenge.
branches.cn: 最古老的义项仍活在法庭上的抗辩里。

branches.en: Both senses need at least two sides.
branches.cn: 两个义项都至少需要两方。

branches.en: Fighting for something and fighting a ruling are close cousins.
branches.cn: 为某物抗争和为裁决抗争，是一对近亲。

intro.en: Contest is built on Latin com-, together, plus testis, a witness.
intro.cn: contest 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 testis（证人）构成。

latinIntro.en: The witness base test- also runs through testify, testimony and protest.
latinIntro.cn: 证人词基 test- 也贯穿 testify、testimony 与 protest。

items.exampleCN: 每位参赛者都拿到了一张卡片。
她无人竞争地赢得了席位。

items.meaning: too clear to be argued against

definition_en: the situation or the words around something that help explain it
core_image: 一段话的左右两边，把中间那句托住
scene: 读到生词时，她先把整段话看一遍再猜意思。You can guess the word from its context.
sceneCN: 这里 context 指「上下文」（第 1 个义项：词语前后相连的文字）；句意是你可以从上下文猜出这个词的意思。

senses.title: Surrounding words
senses.definition: the words before and after a word that help fix its meaning
senses.definitionCN: 位于某词前后、帮助确定其含义的文字
senses.example: Read the whole sentence to get the context.
senses.exampleCN: 读整个句子来把握上下文。
senses.why: A word alone can point several ways, and its neighbours steady it.
senses.whyCN: 一个词单看可以有几种指向，邻居让它稳住。

senses.title: The situation around
senses.definition: the conditions and events that surround something
senses.definitionCN: 围绕某事的条件与事件
senses.example: The decision made sense in the context of that year.
senses.exampleCN: 放在那一年的背景下，这个决定是说得通的。
senses.why: Nothing happens in empty air, and the air explains it.
senses.whyCN: 没有事发生在真空里，周围的空气正好解释它。

senses.title: Setting for meaning
senses.definition: the general field in which an idea is understood
senses.definitionCN: 理解某个观念所依托的整体领域
senses.example: The word has a different force in a legal context.
senses.exampleCN: 这个词在法律语境里力度不同。
senses.why: The same sentence changes colour when the room around it changes.
senses.whyCN: 同一句话，周围的房间一换，颜色也变了。

intro.en: Context comes from Latin contexere, to weave together, built from com-, together, and texere, to weave.
intro.cn: context 来自拉丁语 contexere，意为编织在一起，由 com-（一起）与 texere（编织）构成。

items.en: Texere meant to weave cloth from separate threads.
items.cn: texere 意为把分开的线织成布。

items.en: Contexere meant to weave things into one joined whole.
items.cn: contexere 意为把事物织成一个相连的整体。

items.en: Contextus named the joining of a text as well as a fabric.
items.cn: contextus 既指织物的连接，也指文字的连缀。

items.en: French contexte named the connected body of a written work.
items.cn: 法语 contexte 指一篇文字相连的整体。

items.en: English context first meant the words around a passage.
items.cn: 英语 context 最初指一段话周围的文字。

items.en: The word has widened to mean any surrounding situation.
items.cn: 这个词后来扩大为指任何周围的处境。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin weaving base text-, and the meaning group names other ways of speaking about surroundings.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的编织词基 text-，近义组列出其他表示周边环境的说法。

entries.definition: connected with the situation around something
the written words of a book or message
a false reason given to hide the real one
the conditions that come before and around an event
the place and conditions in which something happens
a fact or condition that affects a situation

normalIntro.en: These hooks start from words woven around a line, then move to the year around a choice and to the field around an idea.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从围绕一句话织起的词开始，再到围绕一个选择的年份，最后到围绕一个观念的领域。

normal.en: Con- is together and text is woven words, so context is words woven around a word.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，text 是织成的文字，context 就是围绕一个词织起来的文字。

normal.en: Pull one sentence out of the page and it may read wrongly.
normal.cn: 把一句话从页面里抽出来，它可能就读歪了。

normal.en: The same word is warm in one letter and cold in another.
normal.cn: 同一个词在一封信里是暖的，在另一封信里是冷的。

normal.en: Ask what was happening that year before you judge the choice.
normal.cn: 判断那个选择之前，先问那一年正在发生什么。

normal.en: A frame tells you how to see the picture inside it.
normal.cn: 画框会告诉你该怎么看框里的画。

abstract.en: Picture threads running in and out of one bright strand.
abstract.cn: 想象许多线在一根亮线两侧穿进穿出。

abstract.en: Picture a lamp lighting the wall behind a small object.
abstract.cn: 想象一盏灯照亮小物件背后的墙面。

abstract.en: Picture a map with one red point and a wide pale field.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图上有一个红点和一大片浅色区域。

examples.en: You can often guess a new word from its context.
examples.cn: 你常常能从上下文猜出一个新词的意思。

examples.en: The remark was harmless in context.
examples.cn: 这句话放在上下文里并无恶意。

examples.en: We need to see the plan in its historical context.
examples.cn: 我们需要把这项计划放回历史背景中看。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 context 记成 con（一起）加 text（文字）：一起摆在旁边的文字，就是上下文。

root: 源自拉丁语 contexere（编织在一起），由 con-（一起）与 texere（编织）构成，本指文字相连，后指上下文与背景。

sensesIntro.en: From words woven around a line, to the year around a choice, and at last to the whole field around an idea.
sensesIntro.cn: 从围绕一句话织起的文字，到围绕一个选择的年份，最后到围绕一个观念的整个领域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: threads weaving in and out of one bright strand.
core.cn: 核心意象：许多线在一根亮线两侧穿进穿出。

branches.en: Neighbouring words decide how a word is taken.
branches.cn: 相邻的词决定一个词该怎么理解。

branches.en: The year around a choice explains the choice.
branches.cn: 选择周围的年月解释了那个选择。

branches.en: A whole field of study gives a word its weight.
branches.cn: 整个研究领域给了一个词分量。

branches.en: Both senses answer the question of what surrounds a thing.
branches.cn: 两个义项都在回答某物被什么包围。

branches.en: A situation and a field both hold an idea in place.
branches.cn: 处境和领域都把某个观念固定住。

intro.en: Context is built on Latin com-, together, plus texere, to weave.
intro.cn: context 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 texere（编织）构成。

latinIntro.en: The weaving base text- also appears in textile, texture and pretext.
latinIntro.cn: 编织词基 text- 也出现在 textile、texture 与 pretext 中。

items.meaningCN: 织在一段话周围的文字
items.example: The line makes sense in context.
items.exampleCN: 这句话放在上下文里说得通。
语境线索对读者有帮助。

items.meaning: in a way tied to the situation
items.exampleCN: 这个短语从语境看很清楚。

items.meaning: to place something in its setting
items.exampleCN: 作者把这封信放回了背景中。

items.meaning: written words as a woven whole
items.example: The text is short but dense.

items.meaning: the feel of a woven surface
items.example: The cloth has a rough texture.

items.meaning: a woven excuse put in front
items.example: He left on a weak pretext.
items.exampleCN: 他找了个勉强的借口离开。

definition_en: to keep doing something after a pause, to go on without stopping, or to stretch further
core_image: 一条路穿过田野，一直伸到看不见的地方
scene: 雨停了一会儿又下起来，队伍仍往前走。They decided to continue the march after a short rest.
sceneCN: 这里 continue 指「继续」（第 1 个义项：停顿之后接着做同一件事）；句意是他们决定稍作休息后继续行军。

senses.title: Keep doing
senses.definition: to go on with an activity after a short pause
senses.definitionCN: 短暂停顿之后接着做同一件事
senses.example: She continued her story after a sip of tea.
senses.exampleCN: 她喝了口茶，接着讲她的故事。
senses.why: A pause is not an ending, for the thread can be picked up again.
senses.whyCN: 停顿不是结束，线还能再捡起来。

senses.title: Go on without stopping
senses.definition: to last or keep happening without a break
senses.definitionCN: 不间断地延续或发生
senses.example: The rain continued all night.
senses.exampleCN: 雨下了一整夜。
senses.why: Some things have no clear edge where they might stop.
senses.whyCN: 有些事物没有明显的边可以让它停下。

senses.title: Stretch onward
senses.definition: to extend further in space
senses.definitionCN: 在空间上向前延伸
senses.example: The path continues beyond the hill.
senses.exampleCN: 小路越过山丘继续延伸。
senses.why: A line drawn on a map asks to be followed.
senses.whyCN: 地图上画出的线，总在请人跟着走。

intro.en: Continue comes from Latin continuare, to join together and carry on, from continuus, unbroken, and before that from continere, to hold together.
intro.cn: continue 来自拉丁语 continuare（连接起来、接着进行），源于 continuus（不间断的），更早出自 continere（保持在一起）。

items.en: Continere meant to hold things together in one piece.
items.cn: continere 意为把事物保持成一个整体。

items.en: Continuus meant hanging together with no break.
items.cn: continuus 意为连在一起而没有断开。

items.en: Continuare meant to make a thing go on further.
items.cn: continuare 意为使某事继续向前。

items.en: French continuer meant to carry on a begun action.
items.cn: 法语 continuer 意为把已开始的动作接着做下去。

items.en: English continue kept both the time and the space senses.
items.cn: 英语 continue 同时保留时间与空间两层意思。

items.en: It now covers pausing, lasting and stretching onward.
items.cn: 如今它涵盖停顿后继续、持续与向前延伸。

note.en: The look-alike group holds the nearest members of the continue family, and the meaning group names other verbs for going on.
note.cn: 形近组收的是 continue 词族里最容易混的几个词，近义组列出其他表示进行下去的动词。

entries.definition: going on with no break at all
happening again and again
the state of staying connected
to move or go on to the next step
to begin something again after a stop
to keep existing for a period

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with a thread taken up again, then move to rain that will not stop and a road that keeps going.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从重新捡起的线开始，再到停不下来的雨，最后到一直往前伸展的路。

normal.en: Con- is together and tin is hold, so continue is holding on to the same thread.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tin 是握住，continue 就是一直握着同一条线。

normal.en: Put down the cup, pick up the sentence: that is the verb.
normal.cn: 放下杯子，重新拿起那句话：这就是这个动词。

normal.en: Rain does not need permission to keep falling.
normal.cn: 雨要继续下，并不需要谁的允许。

normal.en: A path that keeps going is doing the same word in space.
normal.cn: 一条继续向前的小路，是在空间里做同一个词。

normal.en: Stop, breathe, then continue.
normal.cn: 停下，呼吸，然后继续。

abstract.en: Picture a dropped thread lifted from the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一根掉在地上的线被重新捡起。

abstract.en: Picture a page turned, with the sentence running on.
abstract.cn: 想象翻过一页，句子仍在往下走。

abstract.en: Picture a road that narrows but never ends.
abstract.cn: 想象一条越来越窄却始终不结束的路。

examples.en: The meeting will continue after lunch.
examples.cn: 会议将在午饭后继续。

examples.en: The noise continued into the night.
examples.cn: 噪音一直持续到夜里。

examples.en: The valley continues for many miles.
examples.cn: 这条山谷延伸了许多英里。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 continue 记成 con（一起）加 tin（握住）：把线一直握在手里不放，就是继续。

root: 源自拉丁语 continuare（连接起来、接着进行），来自 continuus（不间断的）与 continere（保持在一起），指继续、持续与延伸。

sensesIntro.en: From picking up an action after a pause, to lasting without a break, and at last to stretching through space.
sensesIntro.cn: 从停顿后重新接上动作，到不间断地持续，最后到在空间中向前延伸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thread held in one hand that never leaves it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手握着线，始终没有松开。

branches.en: The first sense picks an action back up.
branches.cn: 第一个义项把动作重新捡起来。

branches.en: The second sense lets time run without a break.
branches.cn: 第二个义项让时间不间断地流。

branches.en: The third sense lays the same idea on the ground.
branches.cn: 第三个义项把同一个意思铺到地面上。

branches.en: Both senses share the refusal to end.
branches.cn: 两个义项都共享不肯结束这一点。

branches.en: What lasts in time can also reach across space.
branches.cn: 在时间里延续的东西，也能横跨空间。

intro.en: Continue is built on Latin com-, together, plus tenere, to hold.
intro.cn: continue 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tenere（握住）构成。

latinIntro.en: The holding base tin- also runs through continuous, continuity and contain.
latinIntro.cn: 握持词基 tin- 也贯穿 continuous、continuity 与 contain。

items.meaning: to keep holding to an action

items.example: The meeting was a continuation of the first.
items.exampleCN: 这次会议是第一次的延续。

items.meaning: to stop something that was going on

items.exampleCN: 接连不断的电话打断了他的专注。

items.meaning: at every moment without a pause

definition_zh: 连续的；不间断的；连绵的
definition_en: happening or existing without any break or gap
core_image: 一笔画到底的直线，中间没有断口
scene: 印刷机一开就停不下来，纸带一直往外送。The press produced a continuous sheet of paper.
sceneCN: 这里 continuous 指「不间断的」（第 1 个义项：中间没有中断）；句意是印刷机送出一整条没有断口的纸。

pos.zh: 连续的；不间断的；连绵的

senses.title: Without a break
senses.definition: going on with no pause or gap in time
senses.definitionCN: 在时间上进行中没有任何停顿或缺口
senses.example: A continuous line runs along the top of the page.
senses.exampleCN: 一条不断的线横贯页面顶端。
senses.why: The eye trusts a line that never lifts from the paper.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛信任一条始终没离开纸面的线。

senses.title: Unbroken in space
senses.definition: covering an area from end to end without gaps
senses.definitionCN: 在空间上从头到尾连成一片没有空隙
senses.example: A continuous wall surrounds the old town.
senses.exampleCN: 一道连绵的墙围着老城。
senses.why: No gate and no crack means the wall reads as one thing.
senses.whyCN: 没有门也没有裂缝，墙就读成一个整体。

senses.title: Steady in supply
senses.definition: provided at every moment over a period of time
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内每一刻都得到供应
senses.example: The plant needs a continuous supply of cool air.
senses.exampleCN: 这座工厂需要持续的冷气供应。
senses.why: Some processes cannot wait for the next delivery.
senses.whyCN: 有些过程等不到下一批货。

intro.en: Continuous comes from Latin continuus, hanging together without a break, from continere, to hold together.
intro.cn: continuous 来自拉丁语 continuus（连在一起、不断开），源于 continere（保持在一起）。

items.en: Continere meant to keep parts in one unbroken whole.
items.cn: continere 意为把各部分保持在一个不断开的整体里。

items.en: Continuus described a line or period with no gap.
items.cn: continuus 形容没有缺口的线或时段。

items.en: The suffix -ous marked a quality in adjectives.
items.cn: 后缀 -ous 在形容词里表示某种性质。

items.en: French continu carried the same unbroken sense.
items.cn: 法语 continu 带有同样的不断义。

items.en: English continuous was used for time, space and motion.
items.cn: 英语 continuous 用于时间、空间与运动。

items.en: It is now carefully kept apart from continual.
items.cn: 如今它被小心地与 continual 区分开。

note.en: The look-alike group sets continuous against its closest relatives, and the meaning group names other words for what does not break.
note.cn: 形近组把 continuous 与最亲近的几个词放在一起，近义组列出其他表示不断开的词。

entries.definition: happening again and again with short breaks
to keep going after a pause
without a pause at any moment
staying the same and never stopping
not interrupted at any point
regular and not changing

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a line that never lifts, then move to a wall without a gate and a supply that never waits.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从始终不抬起的线开始，再到没有门的墙，最后到等不得的供应。

normal.en: Continuous means no gap, while continual means many gaps.
normal.cn: continuous 是没有缺口，continual 是许多缺口。

normal.en: Draw one stroke across the page and do not lift the pen.
normal.cn: 在纸上一笔画过去，不要抬笔。

normal.en: A wall with no gate is continuous, and so is a hum with no pause.
normal.cn: 没有门的墙是不间断的，没有停顿的嗡嗡声也是。

normal.en: Think of a tap that never closes for an hour.
normal.cn: 想一想一只一小时都没关的水龙头。

normal.en: If you can point to a break, the word is not this one.
normal.cn: 只要你能指出一处中断，这个词就不适用。

abstract.en: Picture a single white stroke on a dark page.
abstract.cn: 想象深色纸面上只有一笔白线。

abstract.en: Picture a ribbon pulled tight with no knot.
abstract.cn: 想象一条拉紧、没有打结的丝带。

abstract.en: Picture a river that never shows a dry stone.
abstract.cn: 想象一条从不露出干石的河。

examples.en: The machine needs a continuous supply of water.
examples.cn: 这台机器需要持续供水。

examples.en: A continuous line of cars filled the road.
examples.cn: 一长串不断的车占满了路。

examples.en: The baby slept in a continuous stretch.
examples.cn: 婴儿一口气睡了很久没有醒。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 continuous 记成 continue（继续）加 ous（形容词尾）：一路继下去、中间不断，就是连续的。

root: 源自拉丁语 continuus（连在一起、不断开），来自 continere（保持在一起），加形容词后缀 -ous，指时间或空间上毫无中断。

sensesIntro.en: From time with no pause, to space with no gap, and at last to a supply that never stops arriving.
sensesIntro.cn: 从没有停顿的时间，到没有空隙的空间，最后到从不断供的供应。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one white stroke drawn without lifting the pen.
core.cn: 核心意象：一笔画成、始终没有抬笔的白线。

branches.en: Time runs on without a pause in the first sense.
branches.cn: 第一个义项里时间毫无停顿地流。

branches.en: Space joins end to end in the second sense.
branches.cn: 第二个义项里空间首尾相接。

branches.en: A steady supply keeps the process alive.
branches.cn: 稳定的供应让过程得以维持。

branches.en: Both senses refuse to show a break.
branches.cn: 两个义项都不肯露出一处断口。

branches.en: A wall without a gate and a tap without a stop share one shape.
branches.cn: 没有门的墙与不停的水龙头共用一个形状。

intro.en: Continuous is built on continue plus the adjective ending -ous.
intro.cn: continuous 由 continue 加形容词词尾 -ous 构成。

latinIntro.en: The holding base tin- also appears in continuity, contain and tenant.
latinIntro.cn: 握持词基 tin- 也出现在 continuity、contain 与 tenant 中。

items.meaning: at every moment without a pause

items.meaningCN: 带着短暂间隙一再回来
items.exampleCN: 接连的故障毁了这次旅行。

items.example: The series is a continuation of his early work.
items.exampleCN: 这一系列是他早期作品的延续。

definition_zh: 合同；契约；收缩；染上（疾病）
definition_en: a written agreement between two sides, or to become smaller, or to catch an illness
core_image: 两双手在纸上按下印章，纸边向里卷起
scene: 签完字，双方各留一份，纸被折好放进公文包。Both sides signed the contract on Friday.
sceneCN: 这里 contract 指「合同」（第 1 个义项：双方签下的书面约定）；句意是双方在周五签了这份合同。

senses.title: A written agreement
senses.definition: a formal written promise made between two or more sides
senses.definitionCN: 两方或多方之间作出的正式书面承诺
senses.example: The contract runs for two years.
senses.exampleCN: 这份合同为期两年。
senses.why: A promise on paper outlives the mood that made it.
senses.whyCN: 写在纸上的承诺，比许下它的心情活得更久。

senses.title: To draw smaller
senses.definition: to become shorter, narrower or tighter
senses.definitionCN: 变得更短、更窄或更紧
senses.example: Metal contracts as it cools.
senses.exampleCN: 金属冷却时会收缩。
senses.why: Cold pulls the pieces closer together.
senses.whyCN: 冷把各个部分拉得更近。

senses.title: To catch an illness
senses.definition: to begin to suffer from a disease
senses.definitionCN: 开始患上某种疾病
senses.example: He contracted a fever in the wet season.
senses.exampleCN: 他在雨季染上了热病。
senses.why: An illness can be picked up the way a habit is.
senses.whyCN: 疾病也能像习惯一样被沾染上身。

intro.en: Contract comes from Latin contrahere, to draw together, built from com-, together, and trahere, to draw or pull.
intro.cn: contract 来自拉丁语 contrahere（拉在一起），由 com-（一起）与 trahere（拉）构成。

items.en: Trahere meant to draw or pull something along.
items.cn: trahere 意为拖或拉某物。

items.en: Contrahere meant to pull parts into a smaller space.
items.cn: contrahere 意为把各部分拉进更小的空间。

items.en: The noun contractus named a drawing together, then a bargain.
items.cn: 名词 contractus 先指拉紧，后指订立的约定。

items.en: French contract named a formal agreement.
items.cn: 法语 contract 指正式的约定。

items.en: English contract kept both the agreement and the shrinking senses.
items.cn: 英语 contract 同时保留约定与收缩两层意思。

items.en: The illness sense grew from the idea of being drawn into.
items.cn: 染病义由被卷入其中的想法发展而来。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin drawing base tract-, and the meaning group names other words for agreements and shrinking.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的拉动词基 tract-，近义组列出其他表示约定与收缩的词。

entries.definition: communication or touching between people
a clear difference between things
a firm or person hired to do work
a formal arrangement accepted by both sides
to become smaller in size
to get an illness from somewhere

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with two sides pulled together by a paper, then move to metal pulled smaller and an illness pulled in.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被一纸文书拉到一起的两方开始，再到被拉小的金属，最后到被卷进来的病。

normal.en: Con- is together and tract is pull, so a contract pulls two sides together.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tract 是拉，contract 就是把两方拉到一起。

normal.en: The same pull makes metal shorter and a deal binding.
normal.cn: 同一个拉的动作，让金属变短，也让交易有了约束。

normal.en: A signature turns a talk into a contract.
normal.cn: 一个签名把谈话变成了合同。

normal.en: Cold air contracts a balloon without any paper at all.
normal.cn: 冷空气会让气球收缩，完全不需要纸。

normal.en: A fever can be contracted the way a cold is.
normal.cn: 热病也能像感冒一样被染上。

abstract.en: Picture two hands pulling one sheet tight between them.
abstract.cn: 想象两双手把一张纸在中间拉紧。

abstract.en: Picture a metal band tightening around a barrel.
abstract.cn: 想象一道金属箍在木桶上收紧。

abstract.en: Picture a door closing and drawing the cold inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门关上，把寒气卷进屋里。

examples.en: They signed a contract for the new roof.
examples.cn: 他们为新房顶签了一份合同。

examples.en: The two sides are still under contract.
examples.cn: 双方仍受合同约束。

examples.en: Rubber contracts when it gets cold.
examples.cn: 橡胶遇冷会收缩。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contract 记成 con（一起）加 tract（拉）：把两方拉到一起签下的纸，就是合同；把体积往里拉，就是收缩。

root: 源自拉丁语 contrahere（拉在一起），由 con-（一起）与 trahere（拉）构成，后指合同、收缩与染病。

sensesIntro.en: From two sides pulled together by a written promise, to metal pulled smaller, and at last to an illness drawn in.
sensesIntro.cn: 从被书面承诺拉到一起的两方，到被拉小的金属，最后到被卷进来的疾病。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two hands pulling one sheet tight between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两双手把一张纸在中间拉紧。

branches.en: A written promise binds two sides into one deal.
branches.cn: 书面承诺把两方绑成一桩交易。

branches.en: The pull shows plainly when metal cools.
branches.cn: 金属冷却时，这个拉的动作看得最清楚。

branches.en: An illness is drawn into the body from outside.
branches.cn: 疾病是从外面被拉进身体里的。

branches.en: Both senses come from one picture of pulling tight.
branches.cn: 两个义项都出自拉紧这一幅画面。

branches.en: What is drawn in can be a size or a sickness.
branches.cn: 被拉进来的，可以是体积，也可以是病。

intro.en: Contract is built on Latin com-, together, plus trahere, to draw.
intro.cn: contract 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 trahere（拉）构成。

latinIntro.en: The drawing base tract- also appears in attract, extract and subtract.
latinIntro.cn: 拉动词基 tract- 也出现在 attract、extract 与 subtract 中。

items.meaning: to draw two sides into one deal
items.meaningCN: 把两方拉进同一桩交易
items.exampleCN: 他们与一位建筑商签了约。

items.meaning: a person or firm that takes work
items.meaningCN: 承接工程的个人或公司

items.example: The contraction of the metal was clear.

items.meaning: to touch or get in touch
to draw one number from another
items.meaningCN: 从一个数里减去另一个数

definition_en: a clear difference between things, or to compare them in order to show that difference
core_image: 黑白两块并排放着，边界格外清楚
scene: 展厅里两间屋子刷成一深一浅，站在门口就能看出差别。The contrast between the two rooms is striking.
sceneCN: 这里 contrast 指「对比」（第 1 个义项：并置后显现的差异）；句意是两间屋子的对比非常鲜明。

collocations.phrase: the contrast between A and B
collocations.zh: A 与 B 之间的对比

senses.title: Side-by-side difference
senses.definition: a difference made clear by placing two things together
senses.definitionCN: 把两样东西并置之后显现出来的差异
senses.example: The contrast between the twins is obvious.
senses.exampleCN: 这对双胞胎的差异很明显。
senses.why: Two colours show their edge only next to each other.
senses.whyCN: 两种颜色只有并排时才显出边界。

senses.title: To set against
senses.definition: to compare two things in order to show how they differ
senses.definitionCN: 把两者放在一起比较以显出不同
senses.example: The report contrasts city life with country life.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把城市生活与乡村生活作对照。
senses.why: One picture explains another by standing beside it.
senses.whyCN: 一幅画靠着另一幅，就解释了它。

senses.title: A strong visual difference
senses.definition: the degree of difference between light and dark areas
senses.definitionCN: 明暗区域之间的差异程度
senses.example: Turn up the contrast on the screen.
senses.exampleCN: 把屏幕的反差调高一些。
senses.why: The eye reads edges before it reads shapes.
senses.whyCN: 眼睛先读边缘，再读形状。

intro.en: Contrast comes through French and Italian from Latin contra, against, and stare, to stand, so it first meant standing against.
intro.cn: contrast 经由法语和意大利语，来自拉丁语 contra（反对）与 stare（站立），本义是相对而立。

items.en: Stare meant to stand or stay in place.
items.cn: stare 意为站立或停在原处。

items.en: Contra stare meant to stand over against something.
items.cn: contra stare 意为站在某物的对面。

items.en: Contrasto named a quarrel and a facing of two sides.
items.cn: 意大利语 contrasto 指争执与两方对峙。

items.en: French contraste came to mean a striking difference.
items.cn: 法语 contraste 转指鲜明的差异。

items.en: English contrast was used for art and for argument.
items.cn: 英语 contrast 被用于绘画与论辩。

items.en: The word also names a dial on screens and cameras.
items.cn: 这个词也指屏幕和相机上的调节旋钮。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin standing base st-, and the meaning group names other words for difference and comparison.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的站立词基 st-，近义组列出其他表示差异与比较的词。

entries.definition: completely opposite to something
a formal written agreement
showing a difference between two things
the way in which things are not the same
the act of looking at two things together
the state of being against something

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with two things placed near each other, then move to comparing them and to the sharp edge of light and dark.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从被放在一起的两样东西开始，再到把它们作比较，最后到明暗之间那道利落的边。

normal.en: Contra- is against and st is stand, so contrast is two things standing face to face.
normal.cn: contra- 是相对，st 是站立，contrast 就是两样东西面对面站着。

normal.en: Put black beside white and both look stronger.
normal.cn: 把黑放在白旁边，两者都更有力。

normal.en: The noun is the gap, the verb is the act of showing it.
normal.cn: 名词是那道差距，动词是把它显出来的动作。

normal.en: A screen with more contrast hides the grey between.
normal.cn: 反差调高的屏幕，会藏起中间的灰。

normal.en: No second colour, no contrast.
normal.cn: 没有第二种颜色，就没有对比。

abstract.en: Picture two squares touching along one clean edge.
abstract.cn: 想象两个方块沿一条干净的边相接。

abstract.en: Picture a bright window in a dark wall.
abstract.cn: 想象深色墙上开着一扇明亮的窗。

abstract.en: Picture one hand open and one hand closed.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手张开，一只手握紧。

examples.en: The contrast between the two designs is clear.
examples.cn: 两个设计之间的对比很清楚。

examples.en: In contrast to last year, sales have risen.
examples.cn: 与去年相比，销售额上升了。

examples.en: The essay contrasts two ways of teaching.
examples.cn: 这篇文章对比了两种教学方式。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contrast 记成 contra（相对）加 st（站立）：两样东西面对面站着，差别一眼就看出来，就是对比。

root: 源自拉丁语 contra（反对）与 stare（站立），经由法语和意大利语进入英语，本义是相对而立，后指对比与反差。

sensesIntro.en: From two things placed near each other, to the act of comparing them, and at last to the edge between light and dark.
sensesIntro.cn: 从并排放着的两样东西，到把它们比较的动作，最后到明暗之间的那道边。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a black square laid against a white one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块黑方块紧贴着一块白方块。

branches.en: Nearness makes the difference visible.
branches.cn: 靠近让差异变得可见。

branches.en: The verb does the work of putting them side by side.
branches.cn: 动词负责把它们并排放好。

branches.en: Light and dark give the word a technical life.
branches.cn: 明与暗让这个词有了技术上的用法。

branches.en: A difference and the act of showing it belong together.
branches.cn: 差异和把差异显出来的动作分不开。

branches.en: Comparing and tuning both sharpen an edge.
branches.cn: 作比较与作调节，都是在磨利一条边。

intro.en: Contrast is built on Latin contra, against, plus stare, to stand.
intro.cn: contrast 由拉丁语 contra（相对）与 stare（站立）构成。

latinIntro.en: The standing base st- also appears in stable, statue and constant.
latinIntro.cn: 站立词基 st- 也出现在 stable、statue 与 constant 中。

items.meaning: to stand two things face to face
items.meaningCN: 让两样东西面对面站着

items.meaning: making a difference easy to see
items.exampleCN: 他们穿了对比鲜明的颜色。

items.meaning: to draw into a smaller space
to set two things beside each other
the act of setting things together
items.meaningCN: 把事物并置比较的行为

definition_en: to give money, ideas or effort to help a group or a result, or to write for a publication
core_image: 几只手把各自的硬币放进同一只罐子
scene: 募捐箱摆在门口，路过的人陆续往里放钱。Everyone contributed something to the fund.
sceneCN: 这里 contribute 指「捐助」（第 1 个义项：为共同目的拿出钱物或力气）；句意是每个人都为这笔基金捐了一些。

senses.title: To give a share
senses.definition: to give money, goods or effort to a shared purpose
senses.definitionCN: 为共同的目的拿出钱物或力气
senses.example: Each family contributed food for the feast.
senses.exampleCN: 每户人家都为宴席出了食物。
senses.why: A shared table is filled one dish at a time.
senses.whyCN: 共同的餐桌，是一道菜一道菜填满的。

senses.title: To help cause
senses.definition: to be one of the causes of a result
senses.definitionCN: 成为某个结果的原因之一
senses.example: Poor sleep contributes to low grades.
senses.exampleCN: 睡眠不足会拉低成绩。
senses.why: Big outcomes are rarely made by one hand alone.
senses.whyCN: 大的结果很少只由一只手造成。

senses.title: To write for a publication
senses.definition: to send writing to a paper or magazine
senses.definitionCN: 把文字作品寄给报刊
senses.example: She contributes a column every month.
senses.exampleCN: 她每月写一篇专栏。
senses.why: A page also has a table that others fill.
senses.whyCN: 一个版面也有别人来填的餐桌。

intro.en: Contribute comes from Latin contribuere, to bring together as a share, built from com-, together, and tribuere, to allot.
intro.cn: contribute 来自拉丁语 contribuere（把份额凑到一起），由 com-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

items.en: Tribuere meant to divide out or assign to each.
items.cn: tribuere 意为分发或分给各人。

items.en: Contribuere meant to bring shares into one common fund.
items.cn: contribuere 意为把各份凑进同一个公库。

items.en: The noun contributio named the pooling of shares.
items.cn: 名词 contributio 指各份的汇集。

items.en: French contribuer kept the sense of giving a part.
items.cn: 法语 contribuer 保留了拿出一份的意思。

items.en: English contribute widened to effort and ideas.
items.cn: 英语 contribute 扩大到力气与主意。

items.en: It also means writing for a shared page.
items.cn: 它也指为共同的版面写稿。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the Latin allotting base tribut-, and the meaning group names other words for giving to a shared end.
note.cn: 形近组共享拉丁语的分配词基 tribut-，近义组列出其他表示为共同目标出力的词。

entries.definition: something given to a shared effort
a person who gives or writes for others
to hand something out to many people
to give money or goods to a cause
to put something in with the rest
to provide what is needed

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with coins dropped into one jar, then move to a small cause of a big result and a column sent to a paper.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从投进同一只罐子的硬币开始，再到大结果的小成因，最后到寄给报刊的专栏。

normal.en: Con- is together and tribute is a share, so contribute is putting your share in.
normal.cn: con- 是一起，tribute 是一份，contribute 就是把你那一份放进去。

normal.en: Many small coins make one full jar.
normal.cn: 许多小硬币装满一只罐子。

normal.en: Sleep can contribute to a grade without ever writing an exam.
normal.cn: 睡眠从没参加过考试，却能影响成绩。

normal.en: A column is also a dish brought to a shared table.
normal.cn: 一篇专栏也是端到公共餐桌上的一道菜。

normal.en: Give a part, and the whole grows.
normal.cn: 给出一份，整体就长了一点。

abstract.en: Picture five hands opening over one jar.
abstract.cn: 想象五只手在同一只罐子上方张开。

abstract.en: Picture one drip feeding a whole bucket.
abstract.cn: 想象一滴水喂满一整只桶。

abstract.en: Picture a page filled by many different pens.
abstract.cn: 想象一页纸由许多不同的笔写满。

examples.en: Everyone contributed a little money.
examples.cn: 每个人都捐了一点钱。

examples.en: Wind contributed to the spread of the fire.
examples.cn: 风助长了火势的蔓延。

examples.en: He contributes to a science magazine.
examples.cn: 他为一家科学杂志撰稿。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 contribute 记成 con（一起）加 tribute（给出的一份）：大家各出一份凑到一起，就是贡献。

root: 源自拉丁语 contribuere（把份额凑到一起），由 con-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成，后指贡献、促成与投稿。

sensesIntro.en: From putting a share into a common fund, to being one cause of a result, and at last to writing for a shared page.
sensesIntro.cn: 从把一份放进公库，到成为一个结果的一项成因，最后到为共同版面写稿。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: five hands opening over one jar.
core.cn: 核心意象：五只手在同一只罐子上方张开。

branches.en: The plainest sense puts a share into the pool.
branches.cn: 最朴素的义项是把一份放进公库。

branches.en: A share can also be a cause of what follows.
branches.cn: 一份也可以是后来结果的一项成因。

branches.en: Writing is another way of bringing a dish.
branches.cn: 写稿是端来一道菜的另一种方式。

branches.en: Giving and causing both add something to a whole.
branches.cn: 给予与造成，都是往整体里添东西。

branches.en: A column can also change how readers think.
branches.cn: 一篇专栏也能改变读者的想法。

intro.en: Contribute is built on Latin com-, together, plus tribuere, to allot.
intro.cn: contribute 由拉丁语 com-（一起）与 tribuere（分配）构成。

latinIntro.en: The allotting base tribut- also appears in contribution, tribute and distribute.
latinIntro.cn: 分配词基 tribut- 也出现在 contribution、tribute 与 distribute 中。

items.meaning: to give a share to a common end
a person who gives a share

items.exampleCN: 这一过失起了促成作用。

items.meaning: to say something comes from a cause
items.example: She attributes her success to luck.

items.meaningCN: 为表示敬意而献出的东西
items.example: The song is a tribute to her.

items.meaningCN: 作为惩罚还回去的东西
